english: Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔahwete kɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia no mu, amamfrafoɔ a wɔayi wɔn, 1 # Yak 1.1 Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔahwete kɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia no mu, amamfrafoɔ a wɔayi wɔn,

sɛdeɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nim a ɔnim dada no teɛ no, wɔ honhom ahoteɛ mu, de kɔ asoɔmmerɛ ne Yesu Kristo mogya dwira mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ mmorosoɔ nka mo.2#Rom 8.29 sɛdeɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nim a ɔnim dada no teɛ no, wɔ honhom ahoteɛ mu, de kɔ asoɔmmerɛ ne Yesu Kristo mogya dwira mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ mmorosoɔ nka mo.

Nhyira nka yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyankopɔn ne Agya a ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti ɔnam Yesu Kristo sɔreɛ a ɔfiri awufoɔ mu sɔreeɛ no so awo yɛn foforɔ kɔ anidasoɔ a emu wɔ nkwa mu, 3Nhyira nka yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyankopɔn ne Agya a ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti ɔnam Yesu Kristo sɔreɛ a ɔfiri awufoɔ mu sɔreeɛ no so awo yɛn foforɔ kɔ anidasoɔ a emu wɔ nkwa mu,
ne apɛgyadeɛ a ɛmporɔ, na ɛho nni dɛm, na ɛmpa mu, a wɔde asie ɔsoro ama mo 4#Kol 1.12 ne apɛgyadeɛ a ɛmporɔ, na ɛho nni dɛm, na ɛmpa mu, a wɔde asie ɔsoro ama mo

a wɔnam gyidie so wɛn mo wɔ Nyankopɔn tumi mu de kɔ nkwagyeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ wɔrebɛyi no adie ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu.5#Yoh 10.28; 17.11 a wɔnam gyidie so wɛn mo wɔ Nyankopɔn tumi mu de kɔ nkwagyeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ wɔrebɛyi no adie ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu.

Ɛno mu na mo ho siane mo, mo a nnansa yi, sɛ ɛsɛ a, wɔho mo werɛ kakra, sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu, 6 # Rom 5.2; 2 Ko 4.17; 1 Pe 5.10 Ɛno mu na mo ho siane mo, mo a nnansa yi, sɛ ɛsɛ a, wɔho mo werɛ kakra, sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ bebree mu,

na wɔahunu mo gyidie tɔtorɔtɔɔ sɛ ne boɔ yɛ den pii sene sika, a wɔsɔ hwɛ ogya mu, nanso ɛsɛeɛ, ama ayeyie ne anidie ne animuonyam, Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu. 7#Mmb 17.3; Mal 3.3 na wɔahunu mo gyidie tɔtorɔtɔɔ sɛ ne boɔ yɛ den pii sene sika, a wɔsɔ hwɛ ogya mu, nanso ɛsɛeɛ, ama ayeyie ne anidie ne animuonyam, Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu.

Ɔno na monhunuu no, nanso modɔ no. Ɔno na monhunuu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no die, na mo ho siane mo anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wɔ mu mu, 8#Yoh 20.29; 2 Ko 5.7 Ɔno na monhunuu no, nanso modɔ no. Ɔno na monhunuu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no die, na mo ho siane mo anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wɔ mu mu,
sɛ monya mo gyidie akatua a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no. 9#Rom 6.22 sɛ monya mo gyidie akatua a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no.

Saa nkwagyeɛ no na adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɛbɛba mo soɔ no ho nkɔm de too hɔ no, pɛeɛ na wɔpeepee mu. 10#Luka 10.24 Saa nkwagyeɛ no na adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɛbɛba mo soɔ no ho nkɔm de too hɔ no, pɛeɛ na wɔpeepee mu.

Wɔhwehwɛɛ berɛ ko ne berɛ ahodoɔ a Kristo honhom a ɛwɔ wɔn mu dii kan daa no adi faa n’amanehunu ne akyire animuonyam a ɛbɛba no ho.11#Dwom 22; Yes 53 Wɔhwehwɛɛ berɛ ko ne berɛ ahodoɔ a Kristo honhom a ɛwɔ wɔn mu dii kan daa no adi faa n’amanehunu ne akyire animuonyam a ɛbɛba no ho.

Wɔyi kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn ho nko na wɔsom, na mmom wɔsom mo fa nsɛm a seesei yɛbɔ no dawuro kyerɛ mo ne wɔn a wɔnam Honhom Kronkron a wɔsomaa no firi soro bɛkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Saa nsɛm yi na abɔfoɔ mpo pɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu mu.12 # Efe 3.10 Wɔyi kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn ho nko na wɔsom, na mmom wɔsom mo fa nsɛm a seesei yɛbɔ no dawuro kyerɛ mo ne wɔn a wɔnam Honhom Kronkron a wɔsomaa no firi soro bɛkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Saa nsɛm yi na abɔfoɔ mpo pɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu mu.

Enti mommɔ mo adwene mu abɔsoɔ, mo ani nna hɔ, na momma mo ani nna adom a wɔde rebrɛ mo Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu no so koraa. 13 # Luka 12.35 Enti mommɔ mo adwene mu abɔsoɔ, mo ani nna hɔ, na momma mo ani nna adom a wɔde rebrɛ mo Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu no so koraa.
Monyɛ sɛ asoɔmmerɛ mma, na monnyɛ mo ho sɛdeɛ kane a monnim biribiara no na mo akɔnnɔ teɛ no, 14#Rom 12.2 Monyɛ sɛ asoɔmmerɛ mma, na monnyɛ mo ho sɛdeɛ kane a monnim biribiara no na mo akɔnnɔ teɛ no,
na mmom te sɛ deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo no yɛ kronkron no, mo nso monyɛ kronkron abrabɔ nyinaa mu, 15na mmom te sɛ deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo no yɛ kronkron no, mo nso monyɛ kronkron abrabɔ nyinaa mu,
na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ me, meyɛ kronkron.16#Lew 19.2 na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ me, meyɛ kronkron.

Na sɛ mofrɛ deɛ ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔbu atɛn sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ no sɛ Agya a, momfa suro mmɔ mo bra mo ahɔhobea tenabea yi mu, 17 # Rom 2.11 Na sɛ mofrɛ deɛ ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔbu atɛn sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ no sɛ Agya a, momfa suro mmɔ mo bra mo ahɔhobea tenabea yi mu,

sɛ monim sɛ wɔamfa nnoɔma a ɛporɔ, dwetɛ anaa sika annye mo amfiri mo abrabɔ hunu a mo agyanom de maa mo no mu, 18#1 Ko 6.20; 7.23; 1 Pe 4.3 sɛ monim sɛ wɔamfa nnoɔma a ɛporɔ, dwetɛ anaa sika annye mo amfiri mo abrabɔ hunu a mo agyanom de maa mo no mu,

na mmom wɔde Kristo a ɔte sɛ adwammaa a ɔnni dɛm ne nkekaeɛ no mogya a ne boɔ yɛ den no na ɛgyee mo. 19#Yes 53.7; Heb 9.14 na mmom wɔde Kristo a ɔte sɛ adwammaa a ɔnni dɛm ne nkekaeɛ no mogya a ne boɔ yɛ den no na ɛgyee mo.

Ɔno na wɔyii no sieeɛ ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ, na wɔayi no akyerɛ, berɛ a ɛdi akyire yi mu ama mo 20#Rom 16.25-26; Efe 1.4 Ɔno na wɔyii no sieeɛ ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ, na wɔayi no akyerɛ, berɛ a ɛdi akyire yi mu ama mo

a monam ne so gye Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu na ɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam no die no, na mo gyidie ne anidasoɔ atena Nyankopɔn mu.21#Yoh 14.6 a monam ne so gye Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu na ɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam no die no, na mo gyidie ne anidasoɔ atena Nyankopɔn mu.

Monte mo kra ho, nokorɛ setie mu, nkɔ onuadɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu, na momfiri akoma mu nnodɔ mo ho mo ho denden. 22Monte mo kra ho, nokorɛ setie mu, nkɔ onuadɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu, na momfiri akoma mu nnodɔ mo ho mo ho denden.

Na wɔamfiri aba a ɛporɔ mu, na mmom wɔfiri deɛ ɛmporɔ mu, ɛne sɛ wɔnam Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛte aseɛ na ɛbɛtena hɔ no so awo wɔn foforɔ. 23#Yoh 1.13; Yak 1.18 Na wɔamfiri aba a ɛporɔ mu, na mmom wɔfiri deɛ ɛmporɔ mu, ɛne sɛ wɔnam Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛte aseɛ na ɛbɛtena hɔ no so awo wɔn foforɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ24#Yes 40.6-7; Yak 1.10-11 Ɛfiri sɛ
honam nyinaa te sɛ wira,honam nyinaa te sɛ wira,
na onipa animuonyam nyinaa te sɛ wira nhwiren.na onipa animuonyam nyinaa te sɛ wira nhwiren.
Wira hye,Wira hye,
na ne nhwiren po;na ne nhwiren po;
na Awurade asɛm deɛ, ɛte hɔ daa. Na yei ne asɛmpa a wɔaka akyerɛ mo no.25 # Yes 40.8 na Awurade asɛm deɛ, ɛte hɔ daa. Na yei ne asɛmpa a wɔaka akyerɛ mo no.

Enti monyiyi bɔnepɛ nyinaa ne nnaadaa nyinaa ne nyaatwomyɛ ne nitan ne nsekuro nyinaa nto ngu, 1 # Efe 4.22 Enti monyiyi bɔnepɛ nyinaa ne nnaadaa nyinaa ne nyaatwomyɛ ne nitan ne nsekuro nyinaa nto ngu,

na mompɛ asɛm no nufosuo kronkron mapa, sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔawo wɔn seesei, na moanyini wɔ mu akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, 2#Heb 5.12-13; Mat 18.3 na mompɛ asɛm no nufosuo kronkron mapa, sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔawo wɔn seesei, na moanyini wɔ mu akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu,
berɛ a moaka ahwɛ sɛ Awurade yam yɛ.3#Dwom 34.9 berɛ a moaka ahwɛ sɛ Awurade yam yɛ.

Ɔno na moba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu a nnipa apa no na Onyankopɔn deɛ, wafa no na ne boɔ yɛ den a, 4 # Dwom 118.22 Ɔno na moba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu a nnipa apa no na Onyankopɔn deɛ, wafa no na ne boɔ yɛ den a,

mo nso momma wɔmfa mo sɛ aboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu nto aban, na moayɛ honhom mu dan, asɔfokuo kronkron, sɛ mobɛbɔ honhom mu afɔdeɛ a ɛnam Yesu Kristo so sɔ Nyankopɔn ani. 5#Efe 2.21-22; 1 Pe 2.9; Rom 12.1 mo nso momma wɔmfa mo sɛ aboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu nto aban, na moayɛ honhom mu dan, asɔfokuo kronkron, sɛ mobɛbɔ honhom mu afɔdeɛ a ɛnam Yesu Kristo so sɔ Nyankopɔn ani.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɛwɔ atwerɛ no mu sɛ:6#Yes 28.16 Ɛfiri sɛ ɛwɔ atwerɛ no mu sɛ:

ɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa noɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa no

Na mo deɛ, moyɛ abusua a wɔayi wɔn, ahene asɔfokuo, ɔman kronkron, ɔman a wafa wɔn ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ, sɛ monka deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo firi esum mu baa ne hann a ɛyɛ nwanwa mu no ayeyie nkyerɛ.9 # Eks 19.6; Adi 1.6 Na mo deɛ, moyɛ abusua a wɔayi wɔn, ahene asɔfokuo, ɔman kronkron, ɔman a wafa wɔn ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ, sɛ monka deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo firi esum mu baa ne hann a ɛyɛ nwanwa mu no ayeyie nkyerɛ.
Mo a kane no monyɛ ɔman,10 # Hos 2.23; Rom 9.25 Mo a kane no monyɛ ɔman,
na afei moayɛ Nyankopɔn man,na afei moayɛ Nyankopɔn man,
mo a monnyaa mmɔborɔhunu,mo a monnyaa mmɔborɔhunu,
na afei deɛ, moanya mmɔborɔhunu.na afei deɛ, moanya mmɔborɔhunu.

Adɔfo, metu mo fo sɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ, sɛ monyi mo ho mfiri honam akɔnnɔ a ɛne ɔkra ko no ho, 11 # Dwom 39.12; Yak 4.1 Adɔfo, metu mo fo sɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ, sɛ monyi mo ho mfiri honam akɔnnɔ a ɛne ɔkra ko no ho,

na mommɔ bra pa amanaman mu, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no, wɔhwɛ mo nneyɛɛ pa no a, wɔahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, “nsra da” no.12#Mat 5.16 na mommɔ bra pa amanaman mu, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no, wɔhwɛ mo nneyɛɛ pa no a, wɔahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, “nsra da” no.
Mommrɛ mo ho ase mma nnipa tumidie nyinaa, Awurade nti: Ɔhene a ɔyɛ pumpuni oo, 13 # Rom 13.1-7; Tito 3.1 Mommrɛ mo ho ase mma nnipa tumidie nyinaa, Awurade nti: Ɔhene a ɔyɛ pumpuni oo,
amradofoɔ a ɔsoma wɔn nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe ne papayɛfoɔ ayeyie ho oo. 14amradofoɔ a ɔsoma wɔn nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe ne papayɛfoɔ ayeyie ho oo.
Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mode papayɛ si nnipa a wɔnni adwene no nkwaseasɛm ano, 15#1 Pe 3.16 Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mode papayɛ si nnipa a wɔnni adwene no nkwaseasɛm ano,

sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde ahofadie no ayɛ bɔnepɛ so nkatasoɔ, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nkoa. 16#Gal 5.13 sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde ahofadie no ayɛ bɔnepɛ so nkatasoɔ, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nkoa.
Monni nnipa nyinaa ni! Monnɔ anuanom! Monsuro Onyankopɔn! Monni ɔhene ni!17#Rom 12.10; Mmb 24.21; Mat 22.21 Monni nnipa nyinaa ni! Monnɔ anuanom! Monsuro Onyankopɔn! Monni ɔhene ni!

Nkoa, momfa suro nyinaa mmrɛ mo ho ase mma mo wuranom, ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ na wɔdwoɔ nko, na wɔn a wɔhyɛ mo soɔ no nso bi. 18 # Efe 6.5; Tito 2.9 Nkoa, momfa suro nyinaa mmrɛ mo ho ase mma mo wuranom, ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ na wɔdwoɔ nko, na wɔn a wɔhyɛ mo soɔ no nso bi.

Na yei yɛ animuonyam, sɛ Nyankopɔn ho ahonim nti, obi de awerɛhoɔ hunu amane a ɛmfata no, nanso ɔgyina hɔ pintinn. 19Na yei yɛ animuonyam, sɛ Nyankopɔn ho ahonim nti, obi de awerɛhoɔ hunu amane a ɛmfata no, nanso ɔgyina hɔ pintinn.

Na ɛyɛ animuonyam bɛn, sɛ mofom, na wɔbobɔ mo akuturuku, na moto mo bo ase gyeɛ? Na mmom sɛ moyɛ papa, na mohunu amane, na moto mo bo ase a, yei na ɛyɛ animuonyam, Nyankopɔn anim.20#1 Pe 3.14; 3.17; 4.13-14; Mat 5.10 Na ɛyɛ animuonyam bɛn, sɛ mofom, na wɔbobɔ mo akuturuku, na moto mo bo ase gyeɛ? Na mmom sɛ moyɛ papa, na mohunu amane, na moto mo bo ase a, yei na ɛyɛ animuonyam, Nyankopɔn anim.

Na yei na wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu amane maa mo gyaa mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ monni n’anammɔn akyi.21 # Mat 16.24 Na yei na wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu amane maa mo gyaa mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ monni n’anammɔn akyi.
Ɔno na wanyɛ bɔne,22 # Yes 53.9; Yoh 8.46; 2 Ko 5.21 Ɔno na wanyɛ bɔne,
nanso wɔanhunu nnaadaa n’anomu.nanso wɔanhunu nnaadaa n’anomu.

Ɔno na wɔyaa no, na wanya bie, ɔhunuu amane, nanso wanhunahuna, na mmom ɔde n’asɛm hyɛɛ deɛ ɔbu atɛntenenee no nsa. 23Ɔno na wɔyaa no, na wanya bie, ɔhunuu amane, nanso wanhunahuna, na mmom ɔde n’asɛm hyɛɛ deɛ ɔbu atɛntenenee no nsa.

Ɔno ara na ɔsoaa yɛn bɔne wɔ ne honam mu kɔɔ dua no soɔ, sɛ, sɛ yɛawu ama nnebɔne a, yɛntena ase mma tenenee. Ɔno na wɔde ne mmaa ntampeɛ asa mo yadeɛ. 24#1 Yoh 3.5; Rom 6.11 Ɔno ara na ɔsoaa yɛn bɔne wɔ ne honam mu kɔɔ dua no soɔ, sɛ, sɛ yɛawu ama nnebɔne a, yɛntena ase mma tenenee. Ɔno na wɔde ne mmaa ntampeɛ asa mo yadeɛ.

Na anka mote sɛ nnwan a wɔayera, na afei moasane aba mo kra Hwɛfoɔ ne Wɛmfoɔ no nkyɛn.25#Yes 53.6; Hes 34.5; Yoh 10.12; 1 Pe 5.4 Na anka mote sɛ nnwan a wɔayera, na afei moasane aba mo kra Hwɛfoɔ ne Wɛmfoɔ no nkyɛn.

Saa ara na mo, ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo ara mo kununom, na sɛ ebinom antie asɛm no nso a, wɔafa ɛyerenom abrabɔ a asɛm nni ho so anya wɔn, 1 # Efe 5.22 Saa ara na mo, ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo ara mo kununom, na sɛ ebinom antie asɛm no nso a, wɔafa ɛyerenom abrabɔ a asɛm nni ho so anya wɔn,
sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mo abrabɔ a ɛho teɛ wɔ osuro mu. 2sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mo abrabɔ a ɛho teɛ wɔ osuro mu.
Mommma mo ahyehyɛdeɛ nnyɛ honam ani deɛ, mmɛsawɔ ne sikahyɛ anaa ntadehyɛ mu, 3#Yes 3.18-24; 1 Ti 2.9 Mommma mo ahyehyɛdeɛ nnyɛ honam ani deɛ, mmɛsawɔ ne sikahyɛ anaa ntadehyɛ mu,

na mmom momma no nyɛ akoma mu nipa a wahunta no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ, na ɛyɛ komm adeɛ a ɛmporɔ mu. Ɛno na ne boɔ yɛ den Nyankopɔn anim. 4na mmom momma no nyɛ akoma mu nipa a wahunta no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ, na ɛyɛ komm adeɛ a ɛmporɔ mu. Ɛno na ne boɔ yɛ den Nyankopɔn anim.

Nanso meremma onipa mmɔ wo m’afɔrebukyia ho, na wama w’ani ayɛ siamoo na wahyɛ wo kra awerɛhoɔ; na wo fie dodoɔ bɛwuwu wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu. 33#1 Sa 22.20 Nanso meremma onipa mmɔ wo m’afɔrebukyia ho, na wama w’ani ayɛ siamoo na wahyɛ wo kra awerɛhoɔ; na wo fie dodoɔ bɛwuwu wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu.

Ɛnte saa. 2Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛmpare wo, worenwu; hwɛ, m’agya renyɛ ade kɛseɛ anaa ade ketewa biara gye sɛ ɔyi me asotire ansa; na adɛn nti na m’agya de asɛm yi bɛhunta me? Ɛnte saa.

Ɛnna Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Biribiara a wo kra seɛ no, mɛyɛ ama wo. 4Ɛnna Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Biribiara a wo kra seɛ no, mɛyɛ ama wo.

Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yonatan sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔkyena na ɔsrane fire a ɛsɛ sɛ anka me ne ɔhene kɔtena adidiiɛ; nanso ma menkɔ nkɔhunta wiram nkɔsi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anwummerɛ. 5Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yonatan sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔkyena na ɔsrane fire a ɛsɛ sɛ anka me ne ɔhene kɔtena adidiiɛ; nanso ma menkɔ nkɔhunta wiram nkɔsi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anwummerɛ.

Sɛ w’agya bisa m’akyiri kwan a, ɛnneɛ ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Dawid asrɛ me kwan sɛ ɔretu mmirika akɔ ne kurom Betlehem, na abusua no nyinaa wɔ afirinhyia afɔrebɔ wɔ hɔ. 6Sɛ w’agya bisa m’akyiri kwan a, ɛnneɛ ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Dawid asrɛ me kwan sɛ ɔretu mmirika akɔ ne kurom Betlehem, na abusua no nyinaa wɔ afirinhyia afɔrebɔ wɔ hɔ.

Sɛ ɔka sɛ: Ɛyɛ a, na asomdwoeɛ wɔ hɔ ma w’akoa, na sɛ ne bo fu a, ɛnneɛ hunu sɛ wakyere ne mu sa bɔne. 7Sɛ ɔka sɛ: Ɛyɛ a, na asomdwoeɛ wɔ hɔ ma w’akoa, na sɛ ne bo fu a, ɛnneɛ hunu sɛ wakyere ne mu sa bɔne.

Na yɛ w’akoa adɔeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE apam mu na woama wo ne w’akoa ahyɛne; na sɛ amumuyɛ bi wɔ me mu a, wo ara ku me, na adɛn nti na wode me rekɔma w’agya? 8#1 Sa 18.3 Na yɛ w’akoa adɔeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE apam mu na woama wo ne w’akoa ahyɛne; na sɛ amumuyɛ bi wɔ me mu a, wo ara ku me, na adɛn nti na wode me rekɔma w’agya?

Na Yonatan maa Dawid kaa ne dɔ a ɔde dɔ no no ho ntam bio, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔdɔ no sɛ ɔno ara ne kra.17#1 Sa 18.3 Na Yonatan maa Dawid kaa ne dɔ a ɔde dɔ no no ho ntam bio, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔdɔ no sɛ ɔno ara ne kra.

Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔkyena na ɔsrane fire, na wɔbɛhunu sɛ wonni hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo tenaberɛ bɛda mpan. 18Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔkyena na ɔsrane fire, na wɔbɛhunu sɛ wonni hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo tenaberɛ bɛda mpan.

Na sɛ ɛdi nnansa a, wɔbɛhunu sɛ wonni hɔ ampa ara, ɛnneɛ na siane ntɛm bra deɛ asɛm no baeɛ no, wohuntaeɛ hɔ, na tena Esel boɔ no ho. 19Na sɛ ɛdi nnansa a, wɔbɛhunu sɛ wonni hɔ ampa ara, ɛnneɛ na siane ntɛm bra deɛ asɛm no baeɛ no, wohuntaeɛ hɔ, na tena Esel boɔ no ho.

Na sɛ mese akwankwaa no sɛ: Hwɛ, m’agyan no wɔ w’anim fam nohoa a, ɛnneɛ kɔ, na AWURADE agya wo kwan. 22Na sɛ mese akwankwaa no sɛ: Hwɛ, m’agyan no wɔ w’anim fam nohoa a, ɛnneɛ kɔ, na AWURADE agya wo kwan.
Na asɛm a me ne wo kaeɛ no ho deɛ, hwɛ, AWURADE wɔ me ne wo ntam daa.23Na asɛm a me ne wo kaeɛ no ho deɛ, hwɛ, AWURADE wɔ me ne wo ntam daa.

Na Saulo anka hwee da no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Biribi ayɛ no; ne ho nte; ampa ara ne ho nte. 26 # Lew 15; Deut 23.10 Na Saulo anka hwee da no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Biribi ayɛ no; ne ho nte; ampa ara ne ho nte.

Na Yonatan buaa Saulo sɛ: Dawid srɛɛ me kwan sɛ ɔrekɔ Betlehem, 28Na Yonatan buaa Saulo sɛ: Dawid srɛɛ me kwan sɛ ɔrekɔ Betlehem,

na ɔse: Gya me kwan ɛ, na yɛwɔ abusua afɔrebɔ wɔ kuro no mu, na me nua ahyɛ me sɛ memmra. Enti afei, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ma menkɔ menkɔhwɛ me nuanom. Enti na wamma ɔhene pono ho yi.29na ɔse: Gya me kwan ɛ, na yɛwɔ abusua afɔrebɔ wɔ kuro no mu, na me nua ahyɛ me sɛ memmra. Enti afei, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ma menkɔ menkɔhwɛ me nuanom. Enti na wamma ɔhene pono ho yi.

Ɛnna Saulo bo fuu Yonatan, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo, ɔbaa brakyewni tuateni ba, adɛn menhunuu sɛ woafa Yisai ba no adamfo de rehyɛ wo ho ne wo na adagya mu aniwuo? 30Ɛnna Saulo bo fuu Yonatan, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo, ɔbaa brakyewni tuateni ba, adɛn menhunuu sɛ woafa Yisai ba no adamfo de rehyɛ wo ho ne wo na adagya mu aniwuo?

Na mmerɛ dodoɔ a Yisai ba no te ase asase soɔ yi, wo ne w’ahennie rennyina. Enti soma ma wɔnkɔfa no mmrɛ me, na wuo ara na ɔbɛwuo. 31Na mmerɛ dodoɔ a Yisai ba no te ase asase soɔ yi, wo ne w’ahennie rennyina. Enti soma ma wɔnkɔfa no mmrɛ me, na wuo ara na ɔbɛwuo.

Ɛnna Saulo too pea sɛ ɔde rebɔ no. Na Yonatan hunuu sɛ n’agya awe ataa so sɛ ɔbɛkum Dawid. 33#1 Sa 18.11 Ɛnna Saulo too pea sɛ ɔde rebɔ no. Na Yonatan hunuu sɛ n’agya awe ataa so sɛ ɔbɛkum Dawid.

Na Yonatan de abufuhyeɛ sɔre firii ɛpono no ho, na wannidi bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no. Na ɔdii Dawid ho ya sɛ n’agya asopa no.34Na Yonatan de abufuhyeɛ sɔre firii ɛpono no ho, na wannidi bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no. Na ɔdii Dawid ho ya sɛ n’agya asopa no.
Na anɔpa no Yonatan firii adi kɔɔ wiram deɛ ɔhyɛɛ Dawid no, na abɔfra kumaa bi ka ne ho. 35Na anɔpa no Yonatan firii adi kɔɔ wiram deɛ ɔhyɛɛ Dawid no, na abɔfra kumaa bi ka ne ho.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra no sɛ: Tu mmirika kɔhwehwɛ agyan a merebɛtotoɔ no. Abɔfra no retu mmirika no, ɔtoo agyan no traa no. 36Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra no sɛ: Tu mmirika kɔhwehwɛ agyan a merebɛtotoɔ no. Abɔfra no retu mmirika no, ɔtoo agyan no traa no.

Ɛnna Yonatan de n’akodeɛ no maa abɔfra no na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa kɔ kuro no mu. 40Ɛnna Yonatan de n’akodeɛ no maa abɔfra no na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa kɔ kuro no mu.

Abɔfra no kɔeɛ; na Dawid sɔre firii aboɔkuo no ho, na ɔde n’anim bɛbutuu fam na ɔkotoo mprɛnsa, na wɔfefee wɔn ano, na wɔn baanu sui ara maa Dawid deɛ boroo so. 41#Gye 33.3-4 Abɔfra no kɔeɛ; na Dawid sɔre firii aboɔkuo no ho, na ɔde n’anim bɛbutuu fam na ɔkotoo mprɛnsa, na wɔfefee wɔn ano, na wɔn baanu sui ara maa Dawid deɛ boroo so.

Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu. Sɛdeɛ yɛn baanu akeka AWURADE ntam no, AWURADE ntena me ne wo ntam ne m’asefoɔ ne w’asefoɔ ntam nkɔsi daa. Na ɔsii mu kɔeɛ; na Yonatan baa kuro no mu.42Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu. Sɛdeɛ yɛn baanu akeka AWURADE ntam no, AWURADE ntena me ne wo ntam ne m’asefoɔ ne w’asefoɔ ntam nkɔsi daa. Na ɔsii mu kɔeɛ; na Yonatan baa kuro no mu.

Na Dawid baa Nob Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek nkyɛn. Na Ahimelek de ahopopoɔ bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nko ara wonam na onipa biara nka wo ho yi? 1Na Dawid baa Nob Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek nkyɛn. Na Ahimelek de ahopopoɔ bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nko ara wonam na onipa biara nka wo ho yi?

Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek sɛ: Ɔhene ahyɛ me asɛm bi die, na waka akyerɛ me sɛ: Mma obiara nnhunu adekodeɛ a meresoma wo ho ne deɛ mahyɛ woɔ no ho biribiara; na mmeranteɛ no nso, mahyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ baabi. 2Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek sɛ: Ɔhene ahyɛ me asɛm bi die, na waka akyerɛ me sɛ: Mma obiara nnhunu adekodeɛ a meresoma wo ho ne deɛ mahyɛ woɔ no ho biribiara; na mmeranteɛ no nso, mahyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ baabi.
Na afei, ɛdeɛn na ɛwɔ wo nsam? Ma me paanoo nnum anaa biribiara a wobɛnya. 3Na afei, ɛdeɛn na ɛwɔ wo nsam? Ma me paanoo nnum anaa biribiara a wobɛnya.

Na ɔsɔfoɔ no buaa Dawid sɛ: Paanoo hunu biara nni me nsam, sɛ paanoo kronkron na ɛwɔ hɔ; sɛ mmeranteɛ no akora wɔn ho afiri mmaa ho nko a! 4#Lew 24.5-9; 22.3-7; Eks 19.15 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no buaa Dawid sɛ: Paanoo hunu biara nni me nsam, sɛ paanoo kronkron na ɛwɔ hɔ; sɛ mmeranteɛ no akora wɔn ho afiri mmaa ho nko a!

Na Dawid buaa see ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: Ampa, wɔmma mmaa mmɛn yɛn berɛ biara a yɛrekɔ akɔdi dwuma bi no; na mmeranteɛ no adeɛ ho te, na nkantom nnɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn adeɛ ho teɛ yi. 5Na Dawid buaa see ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: Ampa, wɔmma mmaa mmɛn yɛn berɛ biara a yɛrekɔ akɔdi dwuma bi no; na mmeranteɛ no adeɛ ho te, na nkantom nnɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn adeɛ ho teɛ yi.

Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no de akronkronneɛ no maa no, ɛfiri sɛ na paanoo biara nni hɔ sɛ Kyerɛ paanoo a wɔyi firi AWURADE anim de paanoohyeɛ bɛgu hɔ da a wɔyiiɛ no.6#Mat 12.3 Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no de akronkronneɛ no maa no, ɛfiri sɛ na paanoo biara nni hɔ sɛ Kyerɛ paanoo a wɔyi firi AWURADE anim de paanoohyeɛ bɛgu hɔ da a wɔyiiɛ no.

Nso na Saulo nkoa mu nipa bi wɔ hɔ da no, a wɔato no mu AWURADE anim, ne din de Doeg, Edomni a ɔyɛ Saulo mmoahwɛfoɔ mu panin.7 # 1 Sa 22.9, 18 Nso na Saulo nkoa mu nipa bi wɔ hɔ da no, a wɔato no mu AWURADE anim, ne din de Doeg, Edomni a ɔyɛ Saulo mmoahwɛfoɔ mu panin.

Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ahimelek sɛ: Pea anaa nkrantɛ biara nni wo nsam ha? Na me nkrantɛ ne me nnoɔma mpo mamfa mankura, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene asɛm no, wɔpɛ no ntɛm. 8Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ahimelek sɛ: Pea anaa nkrantɛ biara nni wo nsam ha? Na me nkrantɛ ne me nnoɔma mpo mamfa mankura, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene asɛm no, wɔpɛ no ntɛm.

Na ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Filistini Goliat a wokum no Ela bonhwa mu no nkrantɛ, hwɛ, ɛno na wɔabobɔ no ntoma mu da asɔfotadeɛ no akyire no, ɛno na wobɛfa a, fa, na foforɔ biara nni ha sɛ ɛno. Na Dawid kaa sɛ: Ebi nte sɛ ɛno, fa ma me!
Na Dawid sɔre dwanee da no Saulo anim, na ɔkɔɔ Gathene Akis nkyɛn. 10 # Dwom 56.1 Na Dawid sɔre dwanee da no Saulo anim, na ɔkɔɔ Gathene Akis nkyɛn.

Ɛnna Akis ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Hwɛ, mohunu sɛ onipa yi abɔ dam, na adɛn nti na mode no abrɛ me? 14Ɛnna Akis ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Hwɛ, mohunu sɛ onipa yi abɔ dam, na adɛn nti na mode no abrɛ me?

Na Dawid firi hɔ kɔeɛ, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Adulam bodan mu. Na ne nuanom ne n’agya fie nyinaa teeɛ no, wɔsiane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn hɔ. 1 # Dwom 57.1 Na Dawid firi hɔ kɔeɛ, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Adulam bodan mu. Na ne nuanom ne n’agya fie nyinaa teeɛ no, wɔsiane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn hɔ.

Na wɔn a wɔn ho akyere wɔn ne wɔn a wɔdede aka ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahoɔ boaboaa wɔn ano baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔdii wɔn so safohene. Sɛɛ mo nyinaa moapam me tiri so, na obiara nni hɔ a oyi me asotire, sɛ me ba ne Yisai ba no apam, na mo mu biara nni hɔ a ɔdi me ho ya na ɔyi me asotire sɛ me ba de m’akoa agyina hɔ ne me redi asie, sɛ ɔntɛ me sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ yi? 8#1 Sa 18.3 Sɛɛ mo nyinaa moapam me tiri so, na obiara nni hɔ a oyi me asotire, sɛ me ba ne Yisai ba no apam, na mo mu biara nni hɔ a ɔdi me ho ya na ɔyi me asotire sɛ me ba de m’akoa agyina hɔ ne me redi asie, sɛ ɔntɛ me sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ yi?

Ɛnna Edomni Doeg a ɔno nso gyina Saulo nkoa no nkyɛn no buaa sɛ: Mehunuu Yisai ba no sɛ ɔbaa Nob, Ahitub ba Ahimelek nkyɛn 9#1 Sa 22.22; Dwom 52.1 Ɛnna Edomni Doeg a ɔno nso gyina Saulo nkoa no nkyɛn no buaa sɛ: Mehunuu Yisai ba no sɛ ɔbaa Nob, Ahitub ba Ahimelek nkyɛn

na ɔbisaa AWURADE maa no, na ɔmaa no akwansoduane, na ɔde Filistini Goliat nkrantɛ no maa no.10#1 Sa 21.6, 9 na ɔbisaa AWURADE maa no, na ɔmaa no akwansoduane, na ɔde Filistini Goliat nkrantɛ no maa no.

Ɛnna ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Ahitub ba Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek ne n’agya fie asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Nob no nyinaa, na wɔn nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn. 11Ɛnna ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Ahitub ba Ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek ne n’agya fie asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Nob no nyinaa, na wɔn nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn.

Nnɛ na merefiri aseɛ mabisa Onyankopɔn mama no anaa? Yei mpare me! Mma ɔhene mmfa asɛm bi nnto n’akoa anaa m’agya fie nyinaa so, na w’akoa nnim yeinom nyinaa ho hwee, ketewa oo, kɛseɛ oo! 15Nnɛ na merefiri aseɛ mabisa Onyankopɔn mama no anaa? Yei mpare me! Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ahimelek, wuo ara na wobɛwuo, wo ne w’agya fie nyinaa. 16Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ahimelek, wuo ara na wobɛwuo, wo ne w’agya fie nyinaa.

Na Ahitub ba Ahimelek babarima baako a wɔfrɛ no Abiatar firii mu dwane tii Dawid. 20Na Ahitub ba Ahimelek babarima baako a wɔfrɛ no Abiatar firii mu dwane tii Dawid.

Tena me nkyɛn, nsuro, na deɛ ɔrehwehwɛ me aku me no ara na ɔrehwehwɛ wo nso aku woɔ. Na me nkyɛn deɛ, wɔbɛhwɛ wo so.23Tena me nkyɛn, nsuro, na deɛ ɔrehwehwɛ me aku me no ara na ɔrehwehwɛ wo nso aku woɔ. Na me nkyɛn deɛ, wɔbɛhwɛ wo so.

Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo akoa ne somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔanya gyidie sɛ yɛn deɛ no, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo tenenee mu: 1Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo akoa ne somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔanya gyidie sɛ yɛn deɛ no, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo tenenee mu:
Adom ne asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso mma mo, Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Yesu ho nimdeɛ mu.2Adom ne asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso mma mo, Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Yesu ho nimdeɛ mu.

Sɛdeɛ ne Nyankopɔn fam ahoɔden de nnoɔma a ɛfa nkwa ne onyamesom pa ho nyinaa akyɛ yɛn, deɛ ɔnam animuonyam ne mmaninyɛ so afrɛ yɛn no ho nimdeɛ mu.3 # 1 Pe 2.9 Sɛdeɛ ne Nyankopɔn fam ahoɔden de nnoɔma a ɛfa nkwa ne onyamesom pa ho nyinaa akyɛ yɛn, deɛ ɔnam animuonyam ne mmaninyɛ so afrɛ yɛn no ho nimdeɛ mu.

Ɛno nso so na ɔnam akyɛ yɛn bɔhyɛ a ɛsoso akɛseakɛse a ne boɔ yɛ den, na sɛ moanya adwane akɔnnɔ mu porɔ a ɛwɔ wiase a, moafa yeinom so anya Nyankopɔn su no bi. 4Ɛno nso so na ɔnam akyɛ yɛn bɔhyɛ a ɛsoso akɛseakɛse a ne boɔ yɛ den, na sɛ moanya adwane akɔnnɔ mu porɔ a ɛwɔ wiase a, moafa yeinom so anya Nyankopɔn su no bi.

Yei ara nti na mo nso mommɔ mmɔden nyinaa mfa nka ho, na monkyerɛ mo papayɛ nka gyidie ho, na nimdeɛ nka papayɛ ho, 5#Gal 5.6; 5.22 Yei ara nti na mo nso mommɔ mmɔden nyinaa mfa nka ho, na monkyerɛ mo papayɛ nka gyidie ho, na nimdeɛ nka papayɛ ho,
na anidahɔ nka nimdeɛ ho, na boasetɔ nka anidahɔ ho, 6na anidahɔ nka nimdeɛ ho, na boasetɔ nka anidahɔ ho,
na onyamesom pa nka boasetɔ ho, na onuadɔ nka onyamesom pa ho, na ɔdɔ mapa nka onuadɔ ho. 7#Gal 6.10 na onyamesom pa nka boasetɔ ho, na onuadɔ nka onyamesom pa ho, na ɔdɔ mapa nka onuadɔ ho.

Na sɛ yeinom wɔ mo mu na ɛdɔɔso a, ɛremma monyɛ anihafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔnso aba, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ho nimdeɛ fam. 8Na sɛ yeinom wɔ mo mu na ɛdɔɔso a, ɛremma monyɛ anihafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔnso aba, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ho nimdeɛ fam.

Ɛfiri sɛ deɛ yeinom abɔ no no yɛ onifirani, na n’ani anyam, ɔnhunu akyiri adeɛ, na ne werɛ afiri ne bɔne a wayɛ dada no ho hohorɔ.9#1 Yoh 2.9; 2.11 Ɛfiri sɛ deɛ yeinom abɔ no no yɛ onifirani, na n’ani anyam, ɔnhunu akyiri adeɛ, na ne werɛ afiri ne bɔne a wayɛ dada no ho hohorɔ.

Na saa na wɔbɛma mo kwan aboro soɔ akɔ yɛn Awurade ne yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo daa ahennie no mu.11Na saa na wɔbɛma mo kwan aboro soɔ akɔ yɛn Awurade ne yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo daa ahennie no mu.

Enti meremma m’ani mpa so sɛ mɛkae mo yeinom daa, nanso monim dada, na moatim nokorɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ yi mu. 12Enti meremma m’ani mpa so sɛ mɛkae mo yeinom daa, nanso monim dada, na moatim nokorɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ yi mu.
Nanso mebu no sɛ ɛtene sɛ, mete ntomadan yi mu yi, mede nkaeɛ mekanyane mo, 13#2 Ko 5.1 Nanso mebu no sɛ ɛtene sɛ, mete ntomadan yi mu yi, mede nkaeɛ mekanyane mo,

Na ɛnyɛ anansesɛm a wɔtoo no nyansam akyi na yɛdi kaa mo yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ne ba no ho asɛm, na mmom yɛyɛɛ n’animuonyam kɛseɛ no ho adansefoɔ a na yɛn ani tua. 16Na ɛnyɛ anansesɛm a wɔtoo no nyansam akyi na yɛdi kaa mo yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ne ba no ho asɛm, na mmom yɛyɛɛ n’animuonyam kɛseɛ no ho adansefoɔ a na yɛn ani tua.

Na ɔnyaa anidie ne animuonyam firii Agya Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no, ɛne sɛ saa nne yi firii animuonyam a ɛsɛ ɔkɛseɛ no, baa ne so sɛ: Oyi ne me Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’ani no, 17#Mat 17.5 Na ɔnyaa anidie ne animuonyam firii Agya Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no, ɛne sɛ saa nne yi firii animuonyam a ɛsɛ ɔkɛseɛ no, baa ne so sɛ: Oyi ne me Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’ani no,
yɛn a yɛne no wɔ bepɔ kronkron no soɔ no tee saa nne yi sɛ ɛfiri soro baeɛ.18yɛn a yɛne no wɔ bepɔ kronkron no soɔ no tee saa nne yi sɛ ɛfiri soro baeɛ.

Nanso yɛwɔ adiyifoɔ asɛm a ɛgyina hɔ pintinn kyɛne saa, ɛno na sɛ mohwɛ no yie sɛ kanea a ɛhran baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ kusuu, de kɔsi sɛ adeɛ bɛkye na adekyeeɛ nsoromma no apue mo akoma mu a, moyɛ no yie. 19Nanso yɛwɔ adiyifoɔ asɛm a ɛgyina hɔ pintinn kyɛne saa, ɛno na sɛ mohwɛ no yie sɛ kanea a ɛhran baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ kusuu, de kɔsi sɛ adeɛ bɛkye na adekyeeɛ nsoromma no apue mo akoma mu a, moyɛ no yie.
Monhunu yei kane sɛ atwerɛ mu adiyisɛm biara nnam onipa nkyerɛaseɛ so; 20Monhunu yei kane sɛ atwerɛ mu adiyisɛm biara nnam onipa nkyerɛaseɛ so;

Na bebree bɛdi wɔn ahohwisɛm no akyi, na wɔn nti, wɔbɛka nokorɛ kwan no ho nsɛmmɔne. 2Na bebree bɛdi wɔn ahohwisɛm no akyi, na wɔn nti, wɔbɛka nokorɛ kwan no ho nsɛmmɔne.

Na wɔnam anibereɛ so de nnaadaasɛm bɛpɛ mo ho mfasoɔ. Wɔn na ɛfiri tete wɔn atemmuo ntwentwɛn aseɛ, na wɔn sɛeɛ ntɔ nko.3Na wɔnam anibereɛ so de nnaadaasɛm bɛpɛ mo ho mfasoɔ. Wɔn na ɛfiri tete wɔn atemmuo ntwentwɛn aseɛ, na wɔn sɛeɛ ntɔ nko.

na ɔyii Lot a ɔtene a amumuyɛfoɔ no de wɔn ahohwie abrabɔ haa no, 7na ɔyii Lot a ɔtene a amumuyɛfoɔ no de wɔn ahohwie abrabɔ haa no,

Awurade nim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn a wɔde fɛreɛ som no afiri sɔhwɛ mu, na wama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔntene aso de wɔn asie atemmuo da, 9#1 Ko 10.13; Adi 3.10 Awurade nim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn a wɔde fɛreɛ som no afiri sɔhwɛ mu, na wama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔntene aso de wɔn asie atemmuo da,

ne titire no, wɔn a wɔdi honam akyiri, efi ho akɔnnɔ mu, na wɔte tumidie atua. Na yeinom deɛ, wɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔnni adwene a wɔn su ne sɛ wɔawo wɔn sɛ wɔnkyere wɔn nkum wɔn. Wɔka deɛ wɔnnim ho nsɛmmɔne, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ mu,

na wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛntene so akatua. Deɛ wɔbu no anigyeɛ ne daa ahohwie asetena, wɔyɛ nkekaeɛ ne dɛm, wɔde wɔn apempensie bɔ ahohwie, nanso na wɔne mo redidi, 13na wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛntene so akatua. Deɛ wɔbu no anigyeɛ ne daa ahohwie asetena, wɔyɛ nkekaeɛ ne dɛm, wɔde wɔn apempensie bɔ ahohwie, nanso na wɔne mo redidi,

Na wɔkeka akonkosɛm a hwee nni mu, nam honam akɔnnɔ mu de ahohwisɛm daadaa wɔn a wɔdwane firii wɔn a wɔbɔ nnaadaa bra no mu ɛnkyɛreeɛ. 18Na wɔkeka akonkosɛm a hwee nni mu, nam honam akɔnnɔ mu de ahohwisɛm daadaa wɔn a wɔdwane firii wɔn a wɔbɔ nnaadaa bra no mu ɛnkyɛreeɛ.

Afei kɔ ɔhene nkyɛn na kɔka saa asɛm yi kyerɛ no. Na Yoab de nsɛm no hyɛɛ n’ano.3Afei kɔ ɔhene nkyɛn na kɔka saa asɛm yi kyerɛ no. Na Yoab de nsɛm no hyɛɛ n’ano.
Na ɛberɛ a Tekoani baa no baa ɔhene nkyɛn no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim kaa sɛ: Ɔhene boa me! 4Na ɛberɛ a Tekoani baa no baa ɔhene nkyɛn no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim kaa sɛ: Ɔhene boa me!
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ? Na ɔse: Ampa, meyɛ okunafoɔ, me kunu awu. 5Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ? Na ɔse: Ampa, meyɛ okunafoɔ, me kunu awu.

Na w’afenaa wɔ mmammarima baanu, na wɔn baanu no kɔkoo wiram a ɔpatafoɔ biara nni hɔ, na ɔbaako bɔɔ ɔbaako maa no wui. 6Na w’afenaa wɔ mmammarima baanu, na wɔn baanu no kɔkoo wiram a ɔpatafoɔ biara nni hɔ, na ɔbaako bɔɔ ɔbaako maa no wui.

Na hwɛ, abusua no nyinaa asɔre atia w’afenaa sɛ: Yi deɛ ɔbɔɔ ne nua no ma, na ne nua a wadi no awuo no kra nti yɛnku no. Wɔnam yei so bɛsɛe ɔdedifoɔ no nso, na wɔde rebɛhye m’ase, na wɔannya din anaa okyikafoɔ biara amma me kunu asase so.7#Deut 19.11-13 Na hwɛ, abusua no nyinaa asɔre atia w’afenaa sɛ: Yi deɛ ɔbɔɔ ne nua no ma, na ne nua a wadi no awuo no kra nti yɛnku no. Wɔnam yei so bɛsɛe ɔdedifoɔ no nso, na wɔde rebɛhye m’ase, na wɔannya din anaa okyikafoɔ biara amma me kunu asase so.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: Kɔ wo fie, na mɛhyɛ wo ho mmara bi. 8Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: Kɔ wo fie, na mɛhyɛ wo ho mmara bi.

Na Tekoani baa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Me wura ɔhene, me ne m’agya fie so na ɛso yi nna, na ɔhene ne n’adwa nni bem. 9Na Tekoani baa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Me wura ɔhene, me ne m’agya fie so na ɛso yi nna, na ɔhene ne n’adwa nni bem.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Obi ka wo asɛm bi a, fa no bra me nkyɛn, na ɔrensane nka wo bio. 10Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Obi ka wo asɛm bi a, fa no bra me nkyɛn, na ɔrensane nka wo bio.

Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Ma ɔhene nkae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no ansane ankum bio, na wɔankum me ba. Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma w’afenaa nka me wura ɔhene asɛm bi. Na ɔse: Ka ɛ! 12Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma w’afenaa nka me wura ɔhene asɛm bi. Na ɔse: Ka ɛ!

Na ɔbaa no se: Ɛnneɛ adɛn nti na woasusu saa adeɛ yi Nyankopɔn man ho, na sɛ ɔhene reka saa asɛm yi a, ɔte sɛ deɛ ɔdi fɔ, sɛ ɔhene nkɔfa ne nipa a wɔapam no no nsane mmra fie bio. 13Na ɔbaa no se: Ɛnneɛ adɛn nti na woasusu saa adeɛ yi Nyankopɔn man ho, na sɛ ɔhene reka saa asɛm yi a, ɔte sɛ deɛ ɔdi fɔ, sɛ ɔhene nkɔfa ne nipa a wɔapam no no nsane mmra fie bio.

Ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa wuo, na yɛte sɛ nsuo a wɔahwie agu fam a wɔntumi mmoa ano bio; na Onyankopɔn rekum obi a ɔdwene akwan a ɛremma onipa a wɔapam no nsane mma fie bio. 14#Hes 18.23 Ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa wuo, na yɛte sɛ nsuo a wɔahwie agu fam a wɔntumi mmoa ano bio; na Onyankopɔn rekum obi a ɔdwene akwan a ɛremma onipa a wɔapam no nsane mma fie bio.

Na afei deɛ enti a mebaeɛ na me ne me wura ɔhene abɛka asɛm yi ne sɛ, ɔman no maa mesuroe; na w’afenaa kaa sɛ: Me ne ɔhene bɛkɔ akɔkasa; ebia ɔhene bɛyɛ deɛ n’afenaa abisadeɛ ama no: 15Na afei deɛ enti a mebaeɛ na me ne me wura ɔhene abɛka asɛm yi ne sɛ, ɔman no maa mesuroe; na w’afenaa kaa sɛ: Me ne ɔhene bɛkɔ akɔkasa; ebia ɔhene bɛyɛ deɛ n’afenaa abisadeɛ ama no:

Sɛ ɔhene bɛtie na wayi n’abaawa afiri onipa a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsɛe me ne me ba firi Nyankopɔn agyapadeɛ mu no nsam. 16Sɛ ɔhene bɛtie na wayi n’abaawa afiri onipa a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsɛe me ne me ba firi Nyankopɔn agyapadeɛ mu no nsam.

Na w’afenaa susuu sɛ: Me wura ɔhene asɛm bɛma me asomdwoeɛ, na sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ teɛ no, sɛ me wura ɔhene nso teɛ ne no, sɛ ɔhunu papa ne bɔne mu. Enti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyi.17#2 Sa 19.27 Na w’afenaa susuu sɛ: Me wura ɔhene asɛm bɛma me asomdwoeɛ, na sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ teɛ no, sɛ me wura ɔhene nso teɛ ne no, sɛ ɔhunu papa ne bɔne mu. Enti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyi.

Ɛnna ɔhene bua see ɔbaa no sɛ: Nsi me asɛm biara a merebisa woɔ yi so. Na ɔbaa no se: Ma me wura ɔhene nkasa ɛ! 18Ɛnna ɔhene bua see ɔbaa no sɛ: Nsi me asɛm biara a merebisa woɔ yi so. Na ɔbaa no se: Ma me wura ɔhene nkasa ɛ!

Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Yoab nka wo ho yei nyinaa mu anaa? Na ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: Sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura ɔhene, ɛnyɛ sɛ obi bɛmane nifa anaa benkum afiri deɛ me wura ɔhene aka no nyinaa ho; na w’akoa Yoab na ɔhyɛɛ me, na ɔno ara na ɔde nsɛm yi nyinaa hyɛɛ w’afenaa anomu; 19Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Yoab nka wo ho yei nyinaa mu anaa? Na ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: Sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura ɔhene, ɛnyɛ sɛ obi bɛmane nifa anaa benkum afiri deɛ me wura ɔhene aka no nyinaa ho; na w’akoa Yoab na ɔhyɛɛ me, na ɔno ara na ɔde nsɛm yi nyinaa hyɛɛ w’afenaa anomu;

na sɛ ɔbɛdane asɛm no ani aka nti na w’akoa Yoab ayɛ saa adeɛ yi, nanso me wura ɔhene yɛ onyansafoɔ sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ nyansa teɛ, sɛ ɔbɛhunu deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa.20#2 Sa 14.17 na sɛ ɔbɛdane asɛm no ani aka nti na w’akoa Yoab ayɛ saa adeɛ yi, nanso me wura ɔhene yɛ onyansafoɔ sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ nyansa teɛ, sɛ ɔbɛhunu deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, mema wo kwan, kɔ na kɔfa aberanteɛ Absalom sane bra. 21Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, mema wo kwan, kɔ na kɔfa aberanteɛ Absalom sane bra.

Na Yoab bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ n’anim na ɔhyiraa ɔhene. Na Yoab kaa sɛ: Ɛnnɛ na w’akoa ahunu sɛ manya me wura ɔhene anim adom, sɛ ɔhene ayɛ deɛ n’akoa aka akyerɛ no.22Na Yoab bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ n’anim na ɔhyiraa ɔhene. Ɛno nti Yoab sii mu kɔɔ Gesur kɔfaa Absalom baa Yerusalem. 23 # 2 Sa 13.37 Ɛno nti Yoab sii mu kɔɔ Gesur kɔfaa Absalom baa Yerusalem.

Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ma no mmane nkɔ ne fie, mempɛ sɛ mehunu n’anim. Ɛnna Absalom mane kɔɔ ne fie, na wanhunu ɔhene anim.24Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ma no mmane nkɔ ne fie, mempɛ sɛ mehunu n’anim. Ɛnna Absalom mane kɔɔ ne fie, na wanhunu ɔhene anim.

Nso Israel nyinaa mu na obiara ho nyɛ fɛ sɛ Absalom, na ɛma wɔkamfo no sɛ; ɛfiri ne nan ase kɔsi n’apampam ɛdɛm biara nni ne ho. 25Nso Israel nyinaa mu na obiara ho nyɛ fɛ sɛ Absalom, na ɛma wɔkamfo no sɛ; ɛfiri ne nan ase kɔsi n’apampam ɛdɛm biara nni ne ho.

Na sɛ ɔyi ne ti a, (nso daa afe duru a ɔyi, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ a ne tiri afu dodo,) na wɔkari ne tirinwi no a, ɛyɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu ɔhene abrammoɔ so. 26Na sɛ ɔyi ne ti a, (nso daa afe duru a ɔyi, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ a ne tiri afu dodo,) na wɔkari ne tirinwi no a, ɛyɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu ɔhene abrammoɔ so.
Na wɔwoo mmammarima baasa maa Absalom ne ɔbaa baako a wɔfrɛ no Tamar; ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ne ho yɛ fɛ.27#2 Sa 13.1 Na wɔwoo mmammarima baasa maa Absalom ne ɔbaa baako a wɔfrɛ no Tamar; ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ne ho yɛ fɛ.
Saa nti Absalom dii Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu, nso wanhunu ɔhene anim da. 28Saa nti Absalom dii Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu, nso wanhunu ɔhene anim da.

Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Yoab sɛ ɔrebɛsoma no ɔhene nkyɛn, nso Yoab amma. Na ɔsomaa ne mprenu so, nso wamma. 29Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Yoab sɛ ɔrebɛsoma no ɔhene nkyɛn, nso Yoab amma. Na ɔsomaa ne mprenu so, nso wamma.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asomfoɔ sɛ: Monhwɛ, Yoab afuo wɔ me deɛ ho na ɔwɔ atokoɔ wɔ hɔ, monkɔ nkɔto mu gya. Na Absalom nkoa no kɔtoo afuo no mu gya. 30Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asomfoɔ sɛ: Monhwɛ, Yoab afuo wɔ me deɛ ho na ɔwɔ atokoɔ wɔ hɔ, monkɔ nkɔto mu gya. Na Absalom nkoa no kɔtoo afuo no mu gya.

Ɛnna Yoab sɔre baa Absalom nkyɛn efie bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nkoa de ogya akɔto m’afuo a mewɔ no mu? 31Ɛnna Yoab sɔre baa Absalom nkyɛn efie bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nkoa de ogya akɔto m’afuo a mewɔ no mu?

Na Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, masoma ama wɔaba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Bra ha na mensoma wo ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn nti na mefiri Gesur mebaeɛ? Ɛyɛ ma me sɛ anka meda so mewɔ hɔ. Na afei mɛhunu ɔhene anim; na sɛ ɛso bi da me so a, ɔnku me. 32Na Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, masoma ama wɔaba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Bra ha na mensoma wo ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn nti na mefiri Gesur mebaeɛ? Ɛyɛ ma me sɛ anka meda so mewɔ hɔ. Na afei mɛhunu ɔhene anim; na sɛ ɛso bi da me so a, ɔnku me.

Ɛnna Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no, na ɔfrɛɛ Absalom, na ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim, na ɔhene yɛɛ Absalom atuu.33Ɛnna Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no, na ɔfrɛɛ Absalom, na ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim, na ɔhene yɛɛ Absalom atuu.
Na yei akyiri no, Absalom siesiee teaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ fae, ne mmarima aduonum a wɔbɛwɛn no. 1 # 1 Ah 1.5 Na yei akyiri no, Absalom siesiee teaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ fae, ne mmarima aduonum a wɔbɛwɛn no.

Na Absalom sɔre anɔpahema kɔgyina kuro no pono ano kwan ho. Na obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi na ɔreba ɔhene nkyɛn abɛdie no, Absalom frɛ no bisa no sɛ: Kuro bɛn so na wofire? ɛnna Absalom bɛka akyerɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nsɛm yɛ na ɛtene, nanso obi nni hɔ a ɔhene ayi no a ɔbɛtie ama woɔ. 3ɛnna Absalom bɛka akyerɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nsɛm yɛ na ɛtene, nanso obi nni hɔ a ɔhene ayi no a ɔbɛtie ama woɔ.

Absalom toa so ka sɛ: Na anka meyɛ asase yi so temmufoɔ, me nkyɛn na anka obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi anaa atemmudeɛ bi bɛba na mabu no atɛntenenee. 4Absalom toa so ka sɛ: Na anka meyɛ asase yi so temmufoɔ, me nkyɛn na anka obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi anaa atemmudeɛ bi bɛba na mabu no atɛntenenee.
Na sɛ obi twe pini no bɛbɔ ne mu ase a, ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ne mu yɛ no atuu. 5Na sɛ obi twe pini no bɛbɔ ne mu ase a, ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ne mu yɛ no atuu.

Na saa na na Absalom yɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔba ɔhene nkyɛn asennie nyinaa, na Absalom de nyaa Israel mmarima baa n’afa.6Na saa na na Absalom yɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔba ɔhene nkyɛn asennie nyinaa, na Absalom de nyaa Israel mmarima baa n’afa.

Na mfirinhyia nnan twaa mu no, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma menkɔ menkɔma m’aboadeɛ a mede mehyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ wɔ Hebron. 7Na mfirinhyia nnan twaa mu no, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma menkɔ menkɔma m’aboadeɛ a mede mehyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ wɔ Hebron.

Ɛfiri sɛ metenaa Gesur wɔ Aram no, w’akoa hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE de me sane ba Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ mɛsom AWURADE. 8#Gye 28.20; 2 Sa 13.38 Ɛfiri sɛ metenaa Gesur wɔ Aram no, w’akoa hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE de me sane ba Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ mɛsom AWURADE.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ. Na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Hebron. 9#1 Sa 20.42 Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ. Na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Hebron.

Na Absalom somasomaa akwansrafoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu kodɛɛ sɛ: Mote totorobɛnto nka ara pɛ a, monka sɛ: Absalom adi hene wɔ Hebron. 10Na Absalom somasomaa akwansrafoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu kodɛɛ sɛ: Mote totorobɛnto nka ara pɛ a, monka sɛ: Absalom adi hene wɔ Hebron.

Na mmarima ahanu a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn firi Yerusalem kaa Absalom ho kɔe; na wɔn deɛ, wɔkɔɔ ɔkɔ hunu, na wɔnnim ho hwee. 11Na mmarima ahanu a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn firi Yerusalem kaa Absalom ho kɔe; na wɔn deɛ, wɔkɔɔ ɔkɔ hunu, na wɔnnim ho hwee.

Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Giloni Ahitofel, Dawid fotufoɔ, firii ne kuro Gilo mu, berɛ a ɔrebɔ afɔdeɛ no; na atirisopam no mu yɛɛ den, na nnipa a wɔwɔ Absalom nkyɛn no kɔɔ so dɔɔso ara.12#2 Sa 23.34 Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Giloni Ahitofel, Dawid fotufoɔ, firii ne kuro Gilo mu, berɛ a ɔrebɔ afɔdeɛ no; na atirisopam no mu yɛɛ den, na nnipa a wɔwɔ Absalom nkyɛn no kɔɔ so dɔɔso ara.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Dawid nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Israel mmarima akoma di Absalom akyi. 13Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Dawid nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Israel mmarima akoma di Absalom akyi.

Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔne no wɔ Yerusalem nyinaa sɛ: Monsɔre mma yɛnnwane, na Absalom ammɛku yɛn. Monyɛ ntɛm ma yɛnkɔ, na wammɛto yɛn anyɛ yɛn bɔne bi, na wamfa nkrantɛ ano ammɛbɔ kuro yi. 14#Dwom 3.1 Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔne no wɔ Yerusalem nyinaa sɛ: Monsɔre mma yɛnnwane, na Absalom ammɛku yɛn. Monyɛ ntɛm ma yɛnkɔ, na wammɛto yɛn anyɛ yɛn bɔne bi, na wamfa nkrantɛ ano ammɛbɔ kuro yi.
Na ɔhene nkoa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene pɛ nyinaa no, hwɛ, wo nkoa bɛyɛ. 15Na ɔhene nkoa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene pɛ nyinaa no, hwɛ, wo nkoa bɛyɛ.

Ɛnna ɔhene firii adie na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa dii n’akyi; na ɔhene gyaa ne mpenafoɔ du sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no. 16Ɛnna ɔhene firii adie na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa dii n’akyi; na ɔhene gyaa ne mpenafoɔ du sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no.
Na ɔhene firii adi, na ɔman no nyinaa dii n’akyi, na wɔkɔgyinaa ɛdan bi a ɛtwa toɔ ho. 17Na ɔhene firii adi, na ɔman no nyinaa dii n’akyi, na wɔkɔgyinaa ɛdan bi a ɛtwa toɔ ho.

Na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase ɔhene anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, wo Nyankopɔn a wayi nnipa a wɔmaa wɔn nsa so tiaa me wura ɔhene no ahyɛ wo nsa. 28Na Ahimaas teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ! Na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase ɔhene anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, wo Nyankopɔn a wayi nnipa a wɔmaa wɔn nsa so tiaa me wura ɔhene no ahyɛ wo nsa.

Na ɔhene bisaa sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa? Na Ahimaas buaa sɛ: Yoab resoma ɔhene somfoɔ bi ne w’akoa no, mehunuu kitikiti kɛseɛ bi, na mennim adekodeɛ. 29Na ɔhene bisaa sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa? Na Ahimaas buaa sɛ: Yoab resoma ɔhene somfoɔ bi ne w’akoa no, mehunuu kitikiti kɛseɛ bi, na mennim adekodeɛ.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Sene gyina ha! Na ɔsene kɔgyinaa hɔ.30Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Sene gyina ha! Na ɔsene kɔgyinaa hɔ.

Na hwɛ, Kusni no bae; na Kusni no kaa sɛ: Me wura ɔhene ntie kaseɛ, sɛ AWURADE abu atɛn ama wo nnɛ, wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa woɔ no nyinaa ho. 31Na hwɛ, Kusni no bae; na Kusni no kaa sɛ: Me wura ɔhene ntie kaseɛ, sɛ AWURADE abu atɛn ama wo nnɛ, wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa woɔ no nyinaa ho.

Na ɔhene bisaa Kusni no sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa? Na Kusni no se: Ma me wura ɔhene atamfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ pɛ wo bɔne no nyinaa nyɛ sɛ aberanteɛ no! 32Na ɔhene bisaa Kusni no sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa? Na Kusni no se: Ma me wura ɔhene atamfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ pɛ wo bɔne no nyinaa nyɛ sɛ aberanteɛ no!

Na ɔhene ho popoe, na ɔforo kɔɔ kuro pono so pia mu, na ɔsui. Na ɔrekorɔ no, sɛ ɔkaeɛ nie: Ao, me ba Absalom, me ba, me ba Absalom! Ɛkaa me nko a, anka mesii w’ananmu wui! Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!33Na ɔhene ho popoe, na ɔforo kɔɔ kuro pono so pia mu, na ɔsui. Na ɔrekorɔ no, sɛ ɔkaeɛ nie: Ao, me ba Absalom, me ba, me ba Absalom! Ɛkaa me nko a, anka mesii w’ananmu wui! Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!
Wɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene resu, na ɔretwa Absalom ho adwo. 1Wɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene resu, na ɔretwa Absalom ho adwo.

Na nkonimdie no danee nnipa no nyinaa abooboodie ɛda no; na nkurɔfoɔ no tee da no sɛ ɔhene redi awerɛhoɔ ma ne ba. 2Na nkonimdie no danee nnipa no nyinaa abooboodie ɛda no; na nkurɔfoɔ no tee da no sɛ ɔhene redi awerɛhoɔ ma ne ba.

Na nnipa no wiawiaa wɔn ho baa kuro no mu da no, sɛdeɛ ɛdɔm a wɔredwane ɔko mu wɔ ahohora mu wiawia wɔn ho no. 3Na nnipa no wiawiaa wɔn ho baa kuro no mu da no, sɛdeɛ ɛdɔm a wɔredwane ɔko mu wɔ ahohora mu wiawia wɔn ho no.

Na ɔhene deɛ, na wakata n’anim, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Ao, me ba Absalom, ao, Absalom me ba, me ba! 4Na ɔhene deɛ, na wakata n’anim, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Ao, me ba Absalom, ao, Absalom me ba, me ba!

Na Yoab baa ɔhene nkyɛn efie, na ɔkaa sɛ: Woahyɛ wo nkoa a ɛnnɛ wɔagye wo kra, wo mmammarima, wo mmammaa kra, wo yerenom kra ne wo mpenafoɔ kra no nyinaa aniwuo nnɛ, 5Na Yoab baa ɔhene nkyɛn efie, na ɔkaa sɛ: Woahyɛ wo nkoa a ɛnnɛ wɔagye wo kra, wo mmammarima, wo mmammaa kra, wo yerenom kra ne wo mpenafoɔ kra no nyinaa aniwuo nnɛ,

sɛ wodɔ w’atamfoɔ na wotane w’adɔfoɔ. Na woakyerɛ nnɛ sɛ asafohene ne nkoa nyɛ hwee mma wo; na mahunu sɛ, sɛ Absalom nyaa nkwa na yɛn nyinaa wuwuiɛ a, anka wopɛ. 6sɛ wodɔ w’atamfoɔ na wotane w’adɔfoɔ. Na woakyerɛ nnɛ sɛ asafohene ne nkoa nyɛ hwee mma wo; na mahunu sɛ, sɛ Absalom nyaa nkwa na yɛn nyinaa wuwuiɛ a, anka wopɛ.

Na afei sɔre firi adi, na kɔka abotɔyam asɛm kyerɛ wo nkoa. Na medɔ Nyame sɛ, sɛ woamfiri adi a, obiara rentena wo nkyɛn anadwo yi, na ɛno mmom bɛyɛ bɔne ama wo asene bɔne biara a aba wo soɔ firi wo mmeranteberɛ mu de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ. 7Na afei sɔre firi adi, na kɔka abotɔyam asɛm kyerɛ wo nkoa. Na medɔ Nyame sɛ, sɛ woamfiri adi a, obiara rentena wo nkyɛn anadwo yi, na ɛno mmom bɛyɛ bɔne ama wo asene bɔne biara a aba wo soɔ firi wo mmeranteberɛ mu de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ.

Ɛnna ɔhene sɔre bɛtenaa ase wɔ kuro pono no mu. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene te kuro pono no mu. Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa baa ɔhene anim.8Ɛnna ɔhene sɔre bɛtenaa ase wɔ kuro pono no mu. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene te kuro pono no mu. Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa baa ɔhene anim.
Na Israel deɛ, na wɔadwanedwane kɔ wɔn afie mu. Na Israel deɛ, na wɔadwanedwane kɔ wɔn afie mu.

Na ɔman no nyinaa kasakasaa Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ: Ɔhene gyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfoɔ nsam, na ɔyii yɛn Filistifoɔ nsam; na afei Absalom nti wadwane afiri asase yi so. 9Na ɔman no nyinaa kasakasaa Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ: Ɔhene gyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfoɔ nsam, na ɔyii yɛn Filistifoɔ nsam; na afei Absalom nti wadwane afiri asase yi so.

Na Absalom a yɛsraa no ngo dii yɛn soɔ no nso atɔ dɔm ano; na afei adɛn nti na motwentwɛn sɛ mobɛkɔ akɔfa ɔhene asane aba yi?10Na Absalom a yɛsraa no ngo dii yɛn soɔ no nso atɔ dɔm ano; na afei adɛn nti na motwentwɛn sɛ mobɛkɔ akɔfa ɔhene asane aba yi?

Na Ɔhene Dawid tee deɛ Israel nyinaa aka no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar nkyɛn sɛ: Monkɔbisa nkyerɛ Yuda mpanimfoɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akɔ ne fie? 11Na Ɔhene Dawid tee deɛ Israel nyinaa aka no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar nkyɛn sɛ: Monkɔbisa nkyerɛ Yuda mpanimfoɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akɔ ne fie?

Me nuanom ne mo, me nnompe ne me nam ne mo, na adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akorɔ? 12Me nuanom ne mo, me nnompe ne me nam ne mo, na adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akorɔ?

Na Amasa nso, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me nnompe ne me nam ne wo? Sɛ woanyɛ dɔm so safohene m’anim nna nyinaa ansi Yoab ananmu a, Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sɛɛ na ɔnkɔ so nyɛ me sɛɛ! 13#2 Sa 17.25; 1 Be 2.16-17 Na Amasa nso, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me nnompe ne me nam ne wo? Sɛ woanyɛ dɔm so safohene m’anim nna nyinaa ansi Yoab ananmu a, Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sɛɛ na ɔnkɔ so nyɛ me sɛɛ!

Ɔtwee Yuda mmarima nyinaa bae sɛ onipa baako, na wɔsoma maa wɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Wo ne wo nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, monsane mmra. 14Ɔtwee Yuda mmarima nyinaa bae sɛ onipa baako, na wɔsoma maa wɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Wo ne wo nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, monsane mmra.
Na ɔhene sane baa Yordan ano. Na Yuda baa Gilgal sɛ wɔreba abɛhyia Ɔhene, na wɔde no atwa Yordan.15Na ɔhene sane baa Yordan ano. Na Yuda baa Gilgal sɛ wɔreba abɛhyia Ɔhene, na wɔde no atwa Yordan.

Na Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim no yɛɛ ntɛm ne Yuda mmarima no siane ba bɛhyiaa Ɔhene Dawid, 16 # 1 Ah 2.8 Na Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim no yɛɛ ntɛm ne Yuda mmarima no siane ba bɛhyiaa Ɔhene Dawid,

na Benyamin mmarima apem ka ne ho, na Saulo fie abɔfra Siba ne ne mma dunum ne n’asomfoɔ aduonu no ne no bɛtwaa Yordan baa ɔhene anim. 17#2 Sa 16.1-4; 9.2, 10 na Benyamin mmarima apem ka ne ho, na Saulo fie abɔfra Siba ne ne mma dunum ne n’asomfoɔ aduonu no ne no bɛtwaa Yordan baa ɔhene anim.

Na kodoɔ no twa kɔɔ sɛ wɔde rekɔfa ɔhene fiefoɔ, na wɔayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ. Na ɔhene rebɛtwa Yordan no, Gera ba Simei bɔɔ ne mu ase n’anim, 18Na kodoɔ no twa kɔɔ sɛ wɔde rekɔfa ɔhene fiefoɔ, na wɔayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ. Na ɔhene rebɛtwa Yordan no, Gera ba Simei bɔɔ ne mu ase n’anim,

na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mma me wura mmmu amumuyɛ nnto me so, na nkae deɛ w’akoa fom yɛɛ no da a me wura ɔhene firii Yerusalem no, na ɔhene mmfa nnhyɛ n’akomam. 19#2 Sa 16.5 na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mma me wura mmmu amumuyɛ nnto me so, na nkae deɛ w’akoa fom yɛɛ no da a me wura ɔhene firii Yerusalem no, na ɔhene mmfa nnhyɛ n’akomam.

Na w’akoa nim sɛ mayɛ bɔne; saa nti, hwɛ, me na madi Yosef fie nyinaa kan maba nnɛ sɛ meresiane mabɛhyia me wura ɔhene. 20Na w’akoa nim sɛ mayɛ bɔne; saa nti, hwɛ, me na madi Yosef fie nyinaa kan maba nnɛ sɛ meresiane mabɛhyia me wura ɔhene.
Na Seruia ba Abisai bisaa sɛ: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔkum Simei, sɛ wadome deɛ AWURADE asra no no anaa? 21Na Seruia ba Abisai bisaa sɛ: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔkum Simei, sɛ wadome deɛ AWURADE asra no no anaa?

Na Dawid buaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo Seruia mma wɔ yɛ, sɛ moyɛ sɛ atamfoɔ a wɔne me di asie nnɛ yi? Ɛnnɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum obi Israel anaa? Mennim sɛ ɛnnɛ mene Israel so hene anaa? 22#2 Sa 16.10 Na Dawid buaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo Seruia mma wɔ yɛ, sɛ moyɛ sɛ atamfoɔ a wɔne me di asie nnɛ yi? Ɛnnɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum obi Israel anaa? Mennim sɛ ɛnnɛ mene Israel so hene anaa?
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Wɔrenku wo. Na ɔhene kaa no ne ntam.23Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Wɔrenku wo. Na ɔhene kaa no ne ntam.

Na Saulo ba Mefiboset siane ba bɛhyiaa ɔhene; na ɔnsiesiee ne nan ase, na ɔnyii ne bɔgyesɛ, na ne ntadeɛ nso ɔnsii, firi da a ɔhene kɔeɛ no de bɛsi da a ɔbaa fie asomdwoeɛ mu no. 24 # 2 Sa 9.6 Na Saulo ba Mefiboset siane ba bɛhyiaa ɔhene; na ɔnsiesiee ne nan ase, na ɔnyii ne bɔgyesɛ, na ne ntadeɛ nso ɔnsii, firi da a ɔhene kɔeɛ no de bɛsi da a ɔbaa fie asomdwoeɛ mu no.
Na ɔfirii Yerusalem bɛhyiaa ɔhene no, ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Mefiboset, adɛn nti na wo ne me ankorɔ? 25Na ɔfirii Yerusalem bɛhyiaa ɔhene no, ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Mefiboset, adɛn nti na wo ne me ankorɔ?

Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ao, me wura ɔhene, me somfoɔ no na ɔdaadaa me; na wo somfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hyehyɛ afunumu na mentena no so nkɔ ne ɔhene nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo somfoɔ yɛ apakye. 26Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ao, me wura ɔhene, me somfoɔ no na ɔdaadaa me; na wo somfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hyehyɛ afunumu na mentena no so nkɔ ne ɔhene nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo somfoɔ yɛ apakye.

Na ɔbɛsɛee me kyerɛɛ me wura ɔhene. Na me wura ɔhene te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, enti yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ. 27#2 Sa 16.3; 14.17 Na ɔbɛsɛee me kyerɛɛ me wura ɔhene. Na me wura ɔhene te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, enti yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ.

Na m’agya fie nyinaa nsɛ hwee sɛ owuo mma ma me wura ɔhene, nanso wode wo somfoɔ sii wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ mu, enti kwan bɛn na mewɔ bio, nso ɛdeɛn na mede bɛsu afrɛ ɔhene bio? 28#2 Sa 9.11 Na m’agya fie nyinaa nsɛ hwee sɛ owuo mma ma me wura ɔhene, nanso wode wo somfoɔ sii wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ mu, enti kwan bɛn na mewɔ bio, nso ɛdeɛn na mede bɛsu afrɛ ɔhene bio?

Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woda so ka w’asɛm yi bio? Mese: Wone Siba nkɔkyɛ asase no mu. 29#2 Sa 9.9-10; 16.4 Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woda so ka w’asɛm yi bio? Mese: Wone Siba nkɔkyɛ asase no mu.

Na Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛ me wura ɔhene de asomdwoeɛ anya aba ne fie yi, ma Siba mfa asase nyinaa mpo.30Na Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛ me wura ɔhene de asomdwoeɛ anya aba ne fie yi, ma Siba mfa asase nyinaa mpo.

Na Gileadni Barsilai siane firii Rogelim bae, na ɔne ɔhene twaa Yordan, sɛ ɔrekɔgya no Yordan agya. 31 # 1 Ah 2.7 Na Gileadni Barsilai siane firii Rogelim bae, na ɔne ɔhene twaa Yordan, sɛ ɔrekɔgya no Yordan agya.

Nso na Barsilai abɔ akora sɛ, wadi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe. Na ɔhene tenaa Mahanaim no, ɔno na ɔhwɛɛ no, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ. 32#2 Sa 17.27 Nso na Barsilai abɔ akora sɛ, wadi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe. Na ɔhene tenaa Mahanaim no, ɔno na ɔhwɛɛ no, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Barsilai sɛ: Wo deɛ, wo ne me ntwa nkɔ, na menhwɛ wo me nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem. 33Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Barsilai sɛ: Wo deɛ, wo ne me ntwa nkɔ, na menhwɛ wo me nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem.
Na Barsilai bisaa ɔhene sɛ: Me nkwa nna aka ahe na me ne ɔhene mforo nkɔ Yerusalem yi? 34Na Barsilai bisaa ɔhene sɛ: Me nkwa nna aka ahe na me ne ɔhene mforo nkɔ Yerusalem yi?

Madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe nnɛ, mɛhunu papa ne bɔne mu, anaasɛ w’akoa bɛte deɛ mɛdie ne deɛ mɛnom dɛ, anaasɛ mɛte nnwontofoɔ mmarima ne mmaa nne bio anaa? Na adɛn nti na wo somfoɔ nkɔ so nyɛ adesoa mma me wura ɔhene? 35Madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe nnɛ, mɛhunu papa ne bɔne mu, anaasɛ w’akoa bɛte deɛ mɛdie ne deɛ mɛnom dɛ, anaasɛ mɛte nnwontofoɔ mmarima ne mmaa nne bio anaa? Na adɛn nti na wo somfoɔ nkɔ so nyɛ adesoa mma me wura ɔhene?
Enti wo somfoɔ bɛgya ɔhene kwan Yordan agya ara. Na adɛn nti na ɔhene de akatua yi bɛtua me? 36Enti wo somfoɔ bɛgya ɔhene kwan Yordan agya ara. Na adɛn nti na ɔhene de akatua yi bɛtua me?

Wo kyɛw nie, ma w’akoa nsane nkɔwu ne kurom, n’agya ne ne na damena ho. Na hwɛ, ma wo somfoɔ Kimham ne me wura ɔhene ntwa nkɔ, na yɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ. 37Wo kyɛw nie, ma w’akoa nsane nkɔwu ne kurom, n’agya ne ne na damena ho. Na hwɛ, ma wo somfoɔ Kimham ne me wura ɔhene ntwa nkɔ, na yɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ.

Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Kimham ne me ntwa nkɔ, na mɛyɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ; na biribiara a wobɛhwehwɛ no me hɔ no, mɛyɛ ama wo. 38Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Kimham ne me ntwa nkɔ, na mɛyɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ; na biribiara a wobɛhwehwɛ no me hɔ no, mɛyɛ ama wo.

Na ɔman no nyinaa twaa Yordan, na ɔhene nso twae; na ɔhene yɛɛ no atuu, na ɔhyiraa no maa ɔsane kɔɔ fie.39Na ɔman no nyinaa twaa Yordan, na ɔhene nso twae; na ɔhene yɛɛ no atuu, na ɔhyiraa no maa ɔsane kɔɔ fie.

Na ɔhene sene kɔɔ Gilgal; na Kimham ne no kɔe. Na Yuda man nyinaa ne Israel man fa nso de ɔhene sene kɔe. 40Na ɔhene sene kɔɔ Gilgal; na Kimham ne no kɔe. Na Yuda man nyinaa ne Israel man fa nso de ɔhene sene kɔe.

Na hwɛ, Israel mmarima nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛbisaa ɔhene sɛ: Adɛn nti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima awia wo korɔ, na wɔde ɔhene ne ne fiefoɔ ne Dawid mmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa akɔtwa Yordan aba? 41Na hwɛ, Israel mmarima nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛbisaa ɔhene sɛ: Adɛn nti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima awia wo korɔ, na wɔde ɔhene ne ne fiefoɔ ne Dawid mmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa akɔtwa Yordan aba?

Ɛnna Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene bɛn yɛn. Na adɛn nti na asɛm yi nti mo bo huru mo yi? Yɛadi ɔhene biribi anaasɛ wakyɛ yɛn biribi anaa? 42#2 Sa 19.12-13 Ɛnna Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene bɛn yɛn. Na adɛn nti na asɛm yi nti mo bo huru mo yi? Yɛadi ɔhene biribi anaasɛ wakyɛ yɛn biribi anaa?

Na Israel mmarima no buaa Yuda mmarima sɛ: Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du ɔhene mu, na Dawid mu nso deɛ yɛwɔ sene mo. Adɛn nti na moabu yɛn ketewa, na ɛnyɛ yɛn na yɛdii kan kaa sɛ yɛde ɔhene bɛsane aba? Na Yuda mmarima nsɛm ano yɛɛ den sene Israel mmarima nsɛm no.43Na Israel mmarima no buaa Yuda mmarima sɛ: Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du ɔhene mu, na Dawid mu nso deɛ yɛwɔ sene mo. Ɛno nti ɔhene frɛɛ Gibeonfoɔ no. Nso na Gibeonfoɔ no mfiri Israelfoɔ mu, na mmom wɔyɛ Amorifoɔ nkaeɛ no bi, — na Israelfoɔ aka ntam akyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔrenkum wɔn, nanso Saulo hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔku wɔn wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ maa Israel ne Yudafoɔ no mu. 2#Yos 9.15, 19 Ɛno nti ɔhene frɛɛ Gibeonfoɔ no. Wɔahyɛ mfeɛ aduɔson ahodoɔ nson wɔ wo man ne wo kuro kronkron no so, sɛ wɔnwie mmarato na wɔmma bɔne nwie du, na wɔmpata amumuyɛ na wɔmfa daa tenenee mmra, na wɔnsɔ anisoadehunu ne adiyisɛm ano na wɔnsra akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 24Wɔahyɛ mfeɛ aduɔson ahodoɔ nson wɔ wo man ne wo kuro kronkron no so, sɛ wɔnwie mmarato na wɔmma bɔne nwie du, na wɔmpata amumuyɛ na wɔmfa daa tenenee mmra, na wɔnsɔ anisoadehunu ne adiyisɛm ano na wɔnsra akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron.

Enti hunu sɛ: Ɛfiri asɛm a ɛka sɛ wɔnsane nkyekyere Yerusalem nsi n’ananmu no soɔ de kɔsi ɔberempɔn a wɔasra no soɔ yɛ mfeɛ nson, na mfeɛ nson ahodoɔ aduosia mmienu, wɔbɛsane akyekyere, mmorɔno ne afasuo, nanso ahohiahia berɛ mu na ɛbɛyɛ. 25Enti hunu sɛ: Ɛfiri asɛm a ɛka sɛ wɔnsane nkyekyere Yerusalem nsi n’ananmu no soɔ de kɔsi ɔberempɔn a wɔasra no soɔ yɛ mfeɛ nson, na mfeɛ nson ahodoɔ aduosia mmienu, wɔbɛsane akyekyere, mmorɔno ne afasuo, nanso ahohiahia berɛ mu na ɛbɛyɛ.

Na mehyɛɛ mo atemmufoɔ no mmara berɛ no mu sɛ: Montie mo nuanom ntam nsɛm, na mommu ntɛntenenee onipa ne ne nua ne ne hɔhoɔ ntam. 16#Lew 19.15 Na mehyɛɛ mo atemmufoɔ no mmara berɛ no mu sɛ: Montie mo nuanom ntam nsɛm, na mommu ntɛntenenee onipa ne ne nua ne ne hɔhoɔ ntam.

Na yɛtu firii Horeb, na yɛnante faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a ɛso yɛ hu a mohunuiɛ nyinaa so, Amorifoɔ bepɔ kwan so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no, na yɛduruu Kades-barnea. 19 # Num 20.1 Na yɛtu firii Horeb, na yɛnante faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a ɛso yɛ hu a mohunuiɛ nyinaa so, Amorifoɔ bepɔ kwan so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no, na yɛduruu Kades-barnea.

na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛdeɛ yi so hwɛ ne ɛsodie, 19na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛdeɛ yi so hwɛ ne ɛsodie,

na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom, na wammane amfiri mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.20#Deut 5.32 na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom, na wammane amfiri mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.

Wɔmmma Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ, Lewi abusuakuo nyinaa nnnya kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara Israel mu: AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so adeɛ ne n’agyapadeɛ a wɔnnie; 1 # Deut 10.9; Num 18.8-20; 1 Ko 9.13 Wɔmmma Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ, Lewi abusuakuo nyinaa nnnya kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara Israel mu: AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so adeɛ ne n’agyapadeɛ a wɔnnie;

w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo adikan ne wo nnwan ho nwi a wotwa kane no, fa ma no, 4w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo adikan ne wo nnwan ho nwi a wotwa kane no, fa ma no,

Wɔnnya kyɛfa korɔ nni nka deɛ ɛfiri n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔatɔn mu no ho.8Wɔnnya kyɛfa korɔ nni nka deɛ ɛfiri n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔatɔn mu no ho.

nkaberɛkyerefoɔ, samanfrɛfoɔ, adutofoɔ ne deɛ ɔbisa afunu, 11#1 Sa 28.11 nkaberɛkyerefoɔ, samanfrɛfoɔ, adutofoɔ ne deɛ ɔbisa afunu,

Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a ɔde wɔn asase rema woɔ no, na wotu wɔn tena wɔn nkuro ne wɔn adan mu a, 1 # Num 35.6-34; Yos 20 Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a ɔde wɔn asase rema woɔ no, na wotu wɔn tena wɔn nkuro ne wɔn adan mu a,

bɛkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛahunu n’animuonyam ne ne kɛseyɛ, na yɛate ne nne afiri ogya no mu, ɛnnɛ da yi na yɛahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn ne onipa kasa nanso ɔnya nkwa. 24#Deut 4.33 bɛkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛahunu n’animuonyam ne ne kɛseyɛ, na yɛate ne nne afiri ogya no mu, ɛnnɛ da yi na yɛahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn ne onipa kasa nanso ɔnya nkwa.

Na afei, adɛn nti na yɛnwuo? Ɛfiri sɛ ogya kɛseɛ yi rebɛhye yɛn. Sɛ yɛte AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nne bio a, yɛbɛwuwu. 25Na afei, adɛn nti na yɛnwuo? Ɛfiri sɛ ogya kɛseɛ yi rebɛhye yɛn. Sɛ yɛte AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nne bio a, yɛbɛwuwu.

Na morekasa akyerɛ me no, AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mate ɔman yi nsɛm a wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ no, deɛ wɔaka nyinaa, wɔaka no yie. 28Na morekasa akyerɛ me no, AWURADE tee mo nsɛm no, na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mate ɔman yi nsɛm a wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ no, deɛ wɔaka nyinaa, wɔaka no yie.

O, sɛ anka wɔbɛnya akoma a ɛte seyie na wɔde asuro me adi me mmara nsɛm so nna nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma yie daa ɛ! 29#Deut 29.4; Num 11.29 O, sɛ anka wɔbɛnya akoma a ɛte seyie na wɔde asuro me adi me mmara nsɛm so nna nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma yie daa ɛ!

na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware. 2na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware.

Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so; 6#Deut 11.18-20 Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so;

na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; 7#Gye 18.19 na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu;

na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so.9na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so.

Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo duru asase a ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ, 10Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo duru asase a ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ,

ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotutuiɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛeɛ, na sɛ wodidi mee a, 11#Deut 8.10 ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotutuiɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛeɛ, na sɛ wodidi mee a,

AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka; 13#Deut 10.20; Mat 4.10 AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka;

Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ no; 16 # Mat 4.7; Eks 17.2, 7 Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ no;

na yɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ AWURADE ani soɔ, na asi wo yie, na woakɔ akɔfa asase pa a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no, 18na yɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ AWURADE ani soɔ, na asi wo yie, na woakɔ akɔfa asase pa a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no,
na watu w’atamfo nyinaa afiri w’anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.19#Eks 23.27-28 na watu w’atamfo nyinaa afiri w’anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.

Sɛ ɔkyena bi, wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi? 20 # Eks 13.14 Sɛ ɔkyena bi, wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi?

Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Na anka yɛyɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Misraim; 21#Dwom 44.1 Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Na anka yɛyɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Misraim;

na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fie nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim; 22na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fie nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim;

na yɛn deɛ, ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn nananom no abɛma yɛn. 23na yɛn deɛ, ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn nananom no abɛma yɛn.

Na AWURADE hyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa na yɛnsuro AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, na ɛnsi yɛn yie nna nyinaa, na ɔmma yɛnnya nkwa, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi; 24Na AWURADE hyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa na yɛnsuro AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, na ɛnsi yɛn yie nna nyinaa, na ɔmma yɛnnya nkwa, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi;

na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.25na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.

Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so, na ɔpamo amanaman pii firi w’anim, Hetifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ, aman nson a wɔdɔɔso na wɔn ho yɛ den sene woɔ, 1 # Deut 31.3 Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so, na ɔpamo amanaman pii firi w’anim, Hetifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ, aman nson a wɔdɔɔso na wɔn ho yɛ den sene woɔ,

na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yi wɔn ma wo ma woku wɔn a, ɛnneɛ sɛe wɔn pasapasa; wo ne wɔn mmpam, na nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ; 2#Num 21.2 na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yi wɔn ma wo ma woku wɔn a, ɛnneɛ sɛe wɔn pasapasa; wo ne wɔn mmpam, na nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ;

Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛdane wo mma ani afiri m’akyi, na wɔasom anyame foforɔ, na AWURADE bo afu mo, na wasɛe wo ntɛm. 4Ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛdane wo mma ani afiri m’akyi, na wɔasom anyame foforɔ, na AWURADE bo afu mo, na wasɛe wo ntɛm.

Na mmom sɛ monyɛ wɔn nie: Monnwiridwiri wɔn afɔrebukyia, na mommubu wɔn aboɔ adum, na montwitwa wɔn abosompɔ ngu, na momfa ogya nhye wɔn ahoni. 5#Deut 12.2-3 Na mmom sɛ monyɛ wɔn nie: Monnwiridwiri wɔn afɔrebukyia, na mommubu wɔn aboɔ adum, na montwitwa wɔn abosompɔ ngu, na momfa ogya nhye wɔn ahoni.

Na mo yɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn; mo na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ayi mo sɛ mommɛyɛ ɔman a wafa ayɛ ne dea wɔ aman a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu. 6#Eks 19.5-6 Na mo yɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn; mo na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ayi mo sɛ mommɛyɛ ɔman a wafa ayɛ ne dea wɔ aman a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu.

Ɛnyɛ mo dodoɔ a ɛsene aman nyinaa nti na AWURADE de ne ho abɔ mo ho na wayi mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo na mosua aman nyinaa mu. 7#Efe 2.8 Ɛnyɛ mo dodoɔ a ɛsene aman nyinaa nti na AWURADE de ne ho abɔ mo ho na wayi mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo na mosua aman nyinaa mu.

Na ɛsiane sɛ AWURADE dɔ mo na ɔdi ne ntam a ɔkaa mo nananom no soɔ nti na ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo, na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie firii Misraimhene Farao nsam.8Na ɛsiane sɛ AWURADE dɔ mo na ɔdi ne ntam a ɔkaa mo nananom no soɔ nti na ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo, na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie firii Misraimhene Farao nsam.

Enti hunu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn, — Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ a ɔkora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara nsɛm so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem soɔ, 9 # Eks 20.6 Enti hunu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn, — Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ a ɔkora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara nsɛm so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem soɔ,

na ɔtua wɔn a wɔtane no ka wɔ wɔn anim na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔnyɛ nyaa mma deɛ ɔtane no, ɔbɛtua no ka wɔ n’anim. 10na ɔtua wɔn a wɔtane no ka wɔ wɔn anim na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔnyɛ nyaa mma deɛ ɔtane no, ɔbɛtua no ka wɔ n’anim.
Enti di mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na yɛ.11#Deut 5.32; 6.17 Enti di mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na yɛ.

Na sɛ motie atemmudeɛ yi na modi so yɛ a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛdi apam ne adɔeɛ a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no so ama wo, 12 # Eks 23.22-31 Na sɛ motie atemmudeɛ yi na modi so yɛ a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛdi apam ne adɔeɛ a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no so ama wo,

na wadɔ wo ahyira wo ama woadɔre, na wahyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ne w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma, asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so. 13na wadɔ wo ahyira wo ama woadɔre, na wahyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ne w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma, asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so.
Wɔbɛhyira wo asene aman nyinaa; ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, anaa w’afieboa renyɛ obonini wɔ wo mu. 14Wɔbɛhyira wo asene aman nyinaa; ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, anaa w’afieboa renyɛ obonini wɔ wo mu.

Na AWURADE bɛyi yadeɛ nyinaa afiri wo so, na ɔremfa Misraim yadeɛ bɔne a wonim no biara nto wo so, na ɔde bɛto wɔn a wɔtane woɔ nyinaa so. 15Na AWURADE bɛyi yadeɛ nyinaa afiri wo so, na ɔremfa Misraim yadeɛ bɔne a wonim no biara nto wo so, na ɔde bɛto wɔn a wɔtane woɔ nyinaa so.

Na sɛe aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛma woɔ no nyinaa; mma w’ani nnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno bɛyɛ fidie ama wo.16#Yos 23.13 Na sɛe aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛma woɔ no nyinaa; mma w’ani nnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno bɛyɛ fidie ama wo.
Sɛ wose no w’akoma mu sɛ: Amanaman yi dɔɔso sene me, mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi matu wɔn? 17 # Num 13.31; 14.1-4 Sɛ wose no w’akoma mu sɛ: Amanaman yi dɔɔso sene me, mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi matu wɔn?
Nsuro wɔn, na kae deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa, 18Nsuro wɔn, na kae deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa,

Anuanom, mede deɛ yɛhu no daa no reyɛ mfatoho: Onipa samanseɛ a wɔde nsa ahyɛ aseɛ mpo, obiara ntumi nsesa no, na ɔmmfa bi nka ho. 15Anuanom, mede deɛ yɛhu no daa no reyɛ mfatoho: Onipa samanseɛ a wɔde nsa ahyɛ aseɛ mpo, obiara ntumi nsesa no, na ɔmmfa bi nka ho.

Na Abraham ne n’aseni na wɔhyehyɛɛ wɔn bɔ. Ɔnka sɛ: Na w’asefoɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ nnipa bebree, na mmom ɔse ɔbaako: Na w’aseni, a ɔne Kristo. 16#Gye 22.18 Na Abraham ne n’aseni na wɔhyehyɛɛ wɔn bɔ. Ɔnka sɛ: Na w’asefoɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ nnipa bebree, na mmom ɔse ɔbaako: Na w’aseni, a ɔne Kristo.

Na yei na mereka: Apam a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ no den asie (Kristo mu) no, mmara a mfeɛ ahanan aduasa akyiri ɛbaeɛ no ntumi ntu ngu, na ɛmma bɔhyɛ no nyɛ ɔkwa. 17#Eks 12.40 Na yei na mereka: Apam a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ no den asie (Kristo mu) no, mmara a mfeɛ ahanan aduasa akyiri ɛbaeɛ no ntumi ntu ngu, na ɛmma bɔhyɛ no nyɛ ɔkwa.

Na sɛ apɛgyadeɛ no firi mmara mu a, ɛnneɛ na ɛmfiri bɔhyɛ mu bio; na Abraham deɛ bɔhyɛ so na Onyankopɔn nam de kyɛɛ no.18Na sɛ apɛgyadeɛ no firi mmara mu a, ɛnneɛ na ɛmfiri bɔhyɛ mu bio; na Abraham deɛ bɔhyɛ so na Onyankopɔn nam de kyɛɛ no.

Na afei, mmara no ne deɛn? Mmara atotoatoto nti na wɔde kaa ho, kɔsi sɛ aseni a wɔhyɛɛ bɔ maa no no bɛba; na wɔnam abɔfoɔ so na ɛhyehyɛeɛ wɔ ntamgyinafoɔ bi nsa mu. 19 # Rom 5.20; Aso 7.53 Na afei, mmara no ne deɛn? Mmara atotoatoto nti na wɔde kaa ho, kɔsi sɛ aseni a wɔhyɛɛ bɔ maa no no bɛba; na wɔnam abɔfoɔ so na ɛhyehyɛeɛ wɔ ntamgyinafoɔ bi nsa mu.
Na ntamgyinafoɔ deɛ, ɔnyɛ ɔbaako dea; na Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔbaako. 20Na ntamgyinafoɔ deɛ, ɔnyɛ ɔbaako dea; na Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔbaako.

Ɛnneɛ na mmara tia Nyankopɔn bɔhyɛ anaa? Dabi da. Sɛ wɔmaa mmara bi a ɛbɛtumi ama nkwa deɛ a, anka tenenee firi mmara mu ampa. 21#Rom 8.2-4 Ɛnneɛ na mmara tia Nyankopɔn bɔhyɛ anaa? Dabi da. Sɛ wɔmaa mmara bi a ɛbɛtumi ama nkwa deɛ a, anka tenenee firi mmara mu ampa.

Nanso atwerɛ no aka nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ bɔne ase sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔde bɔhyɛ no afiri Yesu Kristo ho gyidie mu ama wɔn a wɔgye die.22#Rom 3.9-19; 11.32 Nanso atwerɛ no aka nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ bɔne ase sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔde bɔhyɛ no afiri Yesu Kristo ho gyidie mu ama wɔn a wɔgye die.

Na gyidie nnya mmaeɛ no, wɔde yɛn siee mmara ase wɛnn yɛn maa gyidie a wɔrebɛyi no adi akyerɛ no. 23 # Gal 4.3 Na gyidie nnya mmaeɛ no, wɔde yɛn siee mmara ase wɛnn yɛn maa gyidie a wɔrebɛyi no adi akyerɛ no.

Enti, na mmara no yɛ yɛn hwɛfoɔ a ɛkyerɛɛ yɛn Kristo nkyɛn kwan, na ama wɔafiri gyidie mu abu yɛn bem. 24Enti, na mmara no yɛ yɛn hwɛfoɔ a ɛkyerɛɛ yɛn Kristo nkyɛn kwan, na ama wɔafiri gyidie mu abu yɛn bem.
Afei gyidie aba yi, yɛnhyɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ no ase bio, 25#Rom 10.4 Afei gyidie aba yi, yɛnhyɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ no ase bio,
na mmom, mo nyinaa nam gyidie so yɛ Nyankopɔn mma, Kristo Yesu mu. 26#Yoh 1.12; Rom 8.17 na mmom, mo nyinaa nam gyidie so yɛ Nyankopɔn mma, Kristo Yesu mu.
Ɛfiri sɛ, mo mu dodoɔ a wɔabɔ mo asu kɔ Kristo mu no, moahyɛ Kristo. 27#Rom 6.3; 13.14 Ɛfiri sɛ, mo mu dodoɔ a wɔabɔ mo asu kɔ Kristo mu no, moahyɛ Kristo.

Yudani anaa Helani nni hɔ, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ nni hɔ, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa nni hɔ bio; ɛfiri sɛ mo nyinaa yɛ baako, Kristo Yesu mu. 28#Rom 10.12; 1 Ko 12.13 Yudani anaa Helani nni hɔ, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ nni hɔ, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa nni hɔ bio; ɛfiri sɛ mo nyinaa yɛ baako, Kristo Yesu mu.
Na sɛ moyɛ Kristo dea a, ɛnneɛ na moyɛ Abraham asefoɔ, na monam bɔhyɛ no so yɛ adedifoɔ.29#Gal 3.7; Rom 9.7 Na sɛ moyɛ Kristo dea a, ɛnneɛ na moyɛ Abraham asefoɔ, na monam bɔhyɛ no so yɛ adedifoɔ.

Na mese: Ɔdedifoɔ no yɛ akɔkoaa yi, ɔyɛ nnoɔma nyinaa wura deɛ, nanso nsonsonoeɛ biara nna ɔne akoa ntam; 1Na mese: Ɔdedifoɔ no yɛ akɔkoaa yi, ɔyɛ nnoɔma nyinaa wura deɛ, nanso nsonsonoeɛ biara nna ɔne akoa ntam;
na mmom ɔwɔ ahwɛfoɔ ne afiesohwɛfoɔ ase de kɔsi da a agya no ahyɛ asie. 2na mmom ɔwɔ ahwɛfoɔ ne afiesohwɛfoɔ ase de kɔsi da a agya no ahyɛ asie.

Sɛ yɛteɛ ara ne no. Yɛyɛ nkɔkoaa no, wɔde yɛn yɛɛ nkoa hyɛɛ wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ase, 3#Gal 3.23; 5.1; Kol 2.20 Sɛ yɛteɛ ara ne no. Yɛyɛ nkɔkoaa no, wɔde yɛn yɛɛ nkoa hyɛɛ wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ase,
na ɛberɛ no wiee duro no, Onyankopɔn somaa ne ba a ɔbaa woo no maa wɔwoo no mmara ase, 4#Efe 1.10 na ɛberɛ no wiee duro no, Onyankopɔn somaa ne ba a ɔbaa woo no maa wɔwoo no mmara ase,
sɛ ɔmmɛgye wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara ase no, na wɔafa yɛn ayɛ mma. 5#Gal 3.13; 3.26 sɛ ɔmmɛgye wɔn a wɔwɔ mmara ase no, na wɔafa yɛn ayɛ mma.
Na sɛ moyɛ mma nti, Onyankopɔn asoma ne Ba honhom aba mo akoma mu a ɔteam sɛ: Abba, Agya! 6#Rom 8.15 Na sɛ moyɛ mma nti, Onyankopɔn asoma ne Ba honhom aba mo akoma mu a ɔteam sɛ: Abba, Agya!

Enti wonyɛ akoa bio, na mmom ɔba; na sɛ woyɛ ɔba a, wonam Nyankopɔn so yɛ ɔdedifoɔ nso bi.7#Gal 3.29; Rom 8.16-17 Enti wonyɛ akoa bio, na mmom ɔba; na sɛ woyɛ ɔba a, wonam Nyankopɔn so yɛ ɔdedifoɔ nso bi.
Nanso ɛberɛ a monnim Onyankopɔn no, mosom wɔn a wɔn su mu wɔnyɛ anyame no sɛ nkoa. 8Nanso ɛberɛ a monnim Onyankopɔn no, mosom wɔn a wɔn su mu wɔnyɛ anyame no sɛ nkoa.

Na afei a moahunu Onyankopɔn, anaasɛ Onyankopɔn mmom ahu mo yi, adɛn na moasane mo akyiri bio kɔ honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ, na ɛdi hia no ho, na mopɛ sɛ mofiri aseɛ foforɔ som bio? 9Na afei a moahunu Onyankopɔn, anaasɛ Onyankopɔn mmom ahu mo yi, adɛn na moasane mo akyiri bio kɔ honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ, na ɛdi hia no ho, na mopɛ sɛ mofiri aseɛ foforɔ som bio?
Mobu nna ne abosome ne mmerɛ ne mfeɛ. 10#Rom 14.5; Kol 2.16 Mobu nna ne abosome ne mmerɛ ne mfeɛ.
Mesuro wɔ mo ho sɛ ebia maha me ho mama mo kwa.11#2 Yoh 8 Mesuro wɔ mo ho sɛ ebia maha me ho mama mo kwa.
Anuanom, mesrɛ mo, monyɛ sɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ me nso mayɛ sɛ mo. Moanyɛ me bɔne biara, 12 # 2 Ko 2.5 Anuanom, mesrɛ mo, monyɛ sɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ me nso mayɛ sɛ mo. Moanyɛ me bɔne biara,
nso monim sɛ honam mmerɛyɛ so na mekaa asɛmpa no mekyerɛɛ mo kane no, 13#1 Ko 2.3; Aso 16.6 nso monim sɛ honam mmerɛyɛ so na mekaa asɛmpa no mekyerɛɛ mo kane no,

na deɛ ɛyɛɛ sɔhwɛ maa mo me honam mu no, moannwoodwoo me, nso moankyiri me, na mmom mogyee me sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, aane, sɛ Kristo Yesu no ara. 14na deɛ ɛyɛɛ sɔhwɛ maa mo me honam mu no, moannwoodwoo me, nso moankyiri me, na mmom mogyee me sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, aane, sɛ Kristo Yesu no ara.

Na afei mo ahosɛpɛ no wɔ he? Ɛfiri sɛ medi mo adanseɛ sɛ, sɛ ɛbɛtumi a, anka motutuu mo ani maa me. 15Na afei mo ahosɛpɛ no wɔ he? Ɛfiri sɛ medi mo adanseɛ sɛ, sɛ ɛbɛtumi a, anka motutuu mo ani maa me.
Na sɛ meka nokorɛ mekyerɛ mo nti, madane mo tamfoɔ anaa?16#Amos 5.10 Na sɛ meka nokorɛ mekyerɛ mo nti, madane mo tamfoɔ anaa?

Ayɛ sɛ deɛ ebinom pɛ mo yiedie ara ma, nanso wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsi mo kwan, na moapere ahwehwɛ wɔn mmom. 17 # Gal 1.7 Ayɛ sɛ deɛ ebinom pɛ mo yiedie ara ma, nanso wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsi mo kwan, na moapere ahwehwɛ wɔn mmom.
Nanso ɛyɛ sɛ anka wɔbɔ mo yiedie ho mmɔden daa na ɛnyɛ berɛ a me ne mo wɔ hɔ nko. 18Nanso ɛyɛ sɛ anka wɔbɔ mo yiedie ho mmɔden daa na ɛnyɛ berɛ a me ne mo wɔ hɔ nko.
Ao, me mma nkumaa a mereko mo awoɔ bio kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie Kristo suyɛ wɔ mo mu, 19#1 Ko 4.15 Ao, me mma nkumaa a mereko mo awoɔ bio kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie Kristo suyɛ wɔ mo mu,
anka mepɛ sɛ mewɔ mo nkyɛn seesei, na mesakyera me nne, ɛfiri sɛ me tirim ntene me wɔ mo ho.20anka mepɛ sɛ mewɔ mo nkyɛn seesei, na mesakyera me nne, ɛfiri sɛ me tirim ntene me wɔ mo ho.
Mo a mopɛ sɛ mohyɛ mmara aseɛ, monka nkyerɛ me: Monte deɛ mmara no ka anaa? 21 # Gal 4.9; 3.23 Mo a mopɛ sɛ mohyɛ mmara aseɛ, monka nkyerɛ me: Monte deɛ mmara no ka anaa?

Na wɔatwerɛ sɛ na Abraham wɔ mmammarima baanu, ɔbaako yɛ afenaa ba, na ɔbaako yɛ ɔdehyeɛ ba. 22#Gye 16.15; 21.2 Na wɔatwerɛ sɛ na Abraham wɔ mmammarima baanu, ɔbaako yɛ afenaa ba, na ɔbaako yɛ ɔdehyeɛ ba.

Na deɛ ɔyɛ afenaa ba no, wɔwoo no honam kwan so, na ɔdehyeɛ ba no deɛ, wɔnam bɔhyɛ so na ɛwoo no. 23#Rom 9.7-9 Na deɛ ɔyɛ afenaa ba no, wɔwoo no honam kwan so, na ɔdehyeɛ ba no deɛ, wɔnam bɔhyɛ so na ɛwoo no.

Saa adeɛ yi yɛ mfatoho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn baanu no yɛ apam mmienu; ɔbaako firi Sinai bepɔ so a ɔrewo gu nkoayɛ mu, ɔno ne Hagar. 24#Gal 5.1; Rom 8.15 Saa adeɛ yi yɛ mfatoho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn baanu no yɛ apam mmienu; ɔbaako firi Sinai bepɔ so a ɔrewo gu nkoayɛ mu, ɔno ne Hagar.

Na Hagar yɛ Sinai bepɔ a ɛwɔ Arabia; na ɛno ne nnɛ Yerusalem sɛso, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ne mma wɔ nkoasom mu. 25Na Hagar yɛ Sinai bepɔ a ɛwɔ Arabia; na ɛno ne nnɛ Yerusalem sɛso, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ne mma wɔ nkoasom mu.
Na ɔsoro Yerusalem no deɛ, ɛde ne ho, ɛne yɛn na. 26#Heb 12.22 Na ɔsoro Yerusalem no deɛ, ɛde ne ho, ɛne yɛn na.

kyɛne deɛ ɔwɔ kunu no deɛ.kyɛne deɛ ɔwɔ kunu no deɛ.
Na yɛn deɛ, anuanom, sɛdeɛ Isak teɛ no, yɛyɛ bɔhyɛ mma. 28 # Gal 4.23 Na yɛn deɛ, anuanom, sɛdeɛ Isak teɛ no, yɛyɛ bɔhyɛ mma.

Na sɛdeɛ saa berɛ no, deɛ wɔwoo no honam kwan soɔ no taa deɛ wɔwoo no honhom kwan soɔ no, saa ara na ɛteɛ nnɛ nso. 29#Gye 21.9 Na sɛdeɛ saa berɛ no, deɛ wɔwoo no honam kwan soɔ no taa deɛ wɔwoo no honhom kwan soɔ no, saa ara na ɛteɛ nnɛ nso.

Nanso atwerɛ no se deɛn? Pam afenaa no ne ne ba; ɛfiri sɛ afenaa ba no ne ɔdehyeɛ ba no renni adeɛ. 30#Gye 21.10; 21.12 Nanso atwerɛ no se deɛn? Pam afenaa no ne ne ba; ɛfiri sɛ afenaa ba no ne ɔdehyeɛ ba no renni adeɛ.
Enti, anuanom, yɛnyɛ afenaa mma na mmom yɛyɛ ɔdehyeɛ mma.31#Gal 3.29 Enti, anuanom, yɛnyɛ afenaa mma na mmom yɛyɛ ɔdehyeɛ mma.

Adehyedie mu na Kristo ama yɛade yɛn ho. Enti monnyina pintinn, na mommma wɔmmfa akoayɛ kɔnnua ntoatoa mo bio. 1 # Gal 4.5; 4.31; Aso 15.10 Adehyedie mu na Kristo ama yɛade yɛn ho. Enti monnyina pintinn, na mommma wɔmmfa akoayɛ kɔnnua ntoatoa mo bio.
Hwɛ, me Paulo, mese mo sɛ wɔtwa mo twetia a, Kristo ho remma mfasoɔ biara mma mo. 2Hwɛ, me Paulo, mese mo sɛ wɔtwa mo twetia a, Kristo ho remma mfasoɔ biara mma mo.

Mo a mopɛ sɛ wɔbu mo bem mmara no mu no, wɔatete mo afiri Kristo ho, moafiri adom mu ahwe ase. 4Mo a mopɛ sɛ wɔbu mo bem mmara no mu no, wɔatete mo afiri Kristo ho, moafiri adom mu ahwe ase.
Na yɛn deɛ, yɛnam honhom so, firi gyidie mu, twɛn tenenee anidasoɔ. 5Na yɛn deɛ, yɛnam honhom so, firi gyidie mu, twɛn tenenee anidasoɔ.

Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo Yesu mu deɛ, twetiatwa anaa momonotoyɛ nyɛ hwee, na mmom gyidie a ɛnam ɔdɔ so yɛ adwuma.6#Gal 6.15; 1 Ko 7.19 Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo Yesu mu deɛ, twetiatwa anaa momonotoyɛ nyɛ hwee, na mmom gyidie a ɛnam ɔdɔ so yɛ adwuma.
Na moretu mmirika no yie; hwan na ɔsii mo kwan sɛ monntie nokorɛ no? 7Na moretu mmirika no yie; hwan na ɔsii mo kwan sɛ monntie nokorɛ no?
Saa adwensakyera yi mfiri deɛ ɔfrɛ mo no. 8#Gal 1.6 Saa adwensakyera yi mfiri deɛ ɔfrɛ mo no.
Mmɔreka ketewaa bi na ɛka mmɔre no nyinaa. 9#1 Ko 5.6 Mmɔreka ketewaa bi na ɛka mmɔre no nyinaa.

Me deɛ, m’ani da mo so, wɔ Awurade mu sɛ, morennwene biribi foforɔ biara sɛ me deɛ no; na deɛ ɔhaa mo no, sɛ ɔte sɛn dɛn ara a, ɔbɛnya atemmuo. 10#Gal 1.7; 1 Ko 11.15 Me deɛ, m’ani da mo so, wɔ Awurade mu sɛ, morennwene biribi foforɔ biara sɛ me deɛ no; na deɛ ɔhaa mo no, sɛ ɔte sɛn dɛn ara a, ɔbɛnya atemmuo.

Na me deɛ, anuanom, sɛ meda so meka twetiatwasɛm a, anka adɛn na wɔda so taa me? Ɛnneɛ na anka asɛnnua no suntidua no nni hɔ bio. 11#1 Ko 1.23 Na me deɛ, anuanom, sɛ meda so meka twetiatwasɛm a, anka adɛn na wɔda so taa me? Ɛnneɛ na anka asɛnnua no suntidua no nni hɔ bio.
Me nko a, anka wɔn a wɔma monya adwenem sakasaka no, wɔadi wɔn ho awu!12#Dwom 12.3 Me nko a, anka wɔn a wɔma monya adwenem sakasaka no, wɔadi wɔn ho awu!

Anuanom, adehyedie mu na wɔafrɛ mo aba; nanso mommma adehyedie no nyɛ ɔkwan mma honam, na mmom momfa ɔdɔ so nsonsom mo ho. 13 # 1 Pe 2.16 Anuanom, adehyedie mu na wɔafrɛ mo aba; nanso mommma adehyedie no nyɛ ɔkwan mma honam, na mmom momfa ɔdɔ so nsonsom mo ho.

Na sɛ mokeka na momemene mo ho a, monhwɛ yie na moanni mo ho awu.15Na sɛ mokeka na momemene mo ho a, monhwɛ yie na moanni mo ho awu.
